raw.excerpt: The Role Clearstory is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of general contractor accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth.
raw.description:
The Role

Clearstory is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of general contractor accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth. You will report to the Manager of Customer Success and work as an individual contributor with a mixed book of enterprise and mid-market GCs. Our GC customer base is growing and each CSM already carries 20 to 40 accounts, so we need another owner to work every account well.

If you have run change orders as a PM or PE at a general contractor and want to move into tech, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

  • A book of GC accounts. You inherit existing accounts and implement newly sold logos. The book ramps through your first year and reaches 1 to 3 million in ARR in year two, depending on lifecycle stage.
  • Retention and forecasting. Keep your accounts live and renewing by working each one to our written standards, without reminders, and forecast renewals for your own accounts.
  • New GC implementations. Lead post-sale implementation and Project Team Training for net new GCs, so project teams are live and receiving change orders and T&M tags in Clearstory.
  • Adoption. Run check-ins and trainings so field and office users keep using the platform and see the impact.
  • Customer success tools. Use business reviews and other customer success tools to drive retention, adoption, and growth in your accounts.
  • Referrals and growth. Ask for referrals at the right moments and find expansion inside the accounts you own, such as new projects, offices, and additional users. Hand both to the account executive, so your accounts lead to new projects, offices, and companies.
  • Work with Product. Work cross-functionally with the Product team, bringing customer feedback into feature request reviews so what we build matches how GCs work.

What This Role Is Not

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a people manager role and it is not pre-sales. We already have written standards for working each account. Your job is to run them well and raise the bar.

About You

You have worked the general contractor side of change orders, so you know how contracts, budgets, and owner billing work, and you can meet a customer’s situation with one you have lived. You run our standards and practices without handholding or reminders, then improve on them. As an individual contributor, you inspire and motivate the team through your own success, as we cheer each other on and learn from each other. Moving from the field is a real shift, and you will manage your time across many accounts while you learn the role.

The Company You’ll Join

Clearstory is digitizing and automating the change order process inside the commercial construction industry.

Just as TurboTax did for tax documents and Expensify did for receipts and expense reports, Clearstory is doing the same for change order communication and log management by building first-of-its-kind, category defining software that is revolutionizing the commercial construction industry.

The construction industry is being transformed fast by technology, but the way companies communicate costs hasn’t evolved in decades and still heavily relies on carbon copy paper, spreadsheets and email to track billions of dollars. These arcane manual processes can take days or weeks and include hours of manual office tasks such as scanning, manually transcribing, and tedious data-entry into spreadsheets.

At Clearstory we are changing that and creating a new category “change order communication,” by intelligently digitizing this age-old process. This leads to an increase in profits, more successful contractor to customer relationships, more transparency into a project’s true cost, and less wasted paper!

We are a venture backed 100% SaaS company with impressive credentials for a company at our stage.

  • Blue Chip Clients. We have already landed some of the largest General and Subcontractors in the US and have helped our clients build landmark projects.
  • Significant Growth. We continue to double and triple our revenue and platform usage year over year.
  • Large Volumes Processed. Companies share over $100 million in Change Order Requests on our platform each and every month.
  • Significant and Important Projects. Our customers are trusting us to manage significant projects in the commercial construction industry. We have over $100 Billion worth of projects on our platform to date.

Our values: Be Curious, Keep It Simple, Customer Obsession, Raise the Bar.

The Team You’ll Be Surrounded By

In addition to experienced SaaS and product leaders, our team has over 60 years of combined experience in the commercial construction space. At Clearstory we know our customer’s pain points and challenges first hand and have built a category defining product that serves the user first.

You’ll be part of an ambitious and collaborative company, committed to growing a supportive and diverse team that is passionate about empowering our contractor customers.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a project manager or project engineer at a general contractor on the ENR Top 400 (or, as a second choice, a superintendent), with more years preferred. Estimator or preconstruction-only experience does not meet this on its own
  • Owned project financials at a general contractor: budget, contract types, change orders, and pay applications
  • Worked directly with owners or clients on construction projects
  • Worked across multiple markets and projects
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills

Strong plus if you have

  • Business development or sales experience growing client accounts
  • A bachelor’s degree, or equivalent hands-on industry experience
  • Ability to lead strategically and paint a vision that inspires and motivates the team, while also being extremely detail-oriented and getting in the weeds
  • Ability to collaborate with a variety of stakeholders including Senior Post-Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal) across the company
  • Ability to influence and challenge conventional wisdom

Benefits

  • Experience and contribution to the building of our customer success strategy, including how we onboard customers, how we help them grow, how we communicate value to them, and how we gather feedback to improve the product
  • Ability to work with a new product category that has already found product market fit
  • Experience at a venture backed growth startup
  • Unlimited PTO and company holidays
  • Flexible remote work
  • Competitive market-rate salary for a Series B company
  • Subsidized healthcare, vision, and dental
  • 401(k) plan
  • Equity

raw.excerpt: 🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity!  We're Hiring a Meta Ads Specialist!
raw.description:
🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring a Meta Ads Specialist! 🌟

Are you a proactive, creative-minded marketer whose core mission is to beat creative fatigue? We are looking for an exceptional Meta Ads Specialist to join a performance-driven marketing agency and help scale construction businesses with proven lead generation systems!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: Meta Ads Specialist

  • Job ID: MOHTIA1R

  • Industry: Digital Marketing Industry

  • Location: Lebanon

  • Job Status: Full Time

  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Mountain Time

  • Salary: $5.75 to $8.50 per hour / Monthly Equivalent: $1,000 to $1,500 per month

  • Target Start Date: ASAP

🏢 About the Client

The client is a performance-driven marketing agency that specializes in generating high-quality leads for construction businesses through Facebook advertising. With a strong focus on client results and business growth, the agency helps contractors scale efficiently with proven lead generation systems and expert marketing support.

💼 About the Role

Our client is looking for a proactive, creative-minded Meta Ads Specialist whose core mission is to beat creative fatigue across our clients' ad accounts. Each day, you will log into client ad accounts, identify which creatives are fatiguing, and produce fresh, high-performing replacements from the photos and videos our clients send. You'll be editing videos, editing photos, building collages, and using AI tools to generate new creatives, then upload them to the account and keep backups ready.

Success in this role comes down to two things: understanding Meta ads and understanding creatives. If you know both, you can beat creative fatigue. GoHighLevel experience is a plus—we build our CRMs and landing pages on GHL, but if you don’t have it, we will teach you.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 📈 Campaign Creation & Management: Build and launch Meta campaigns across multiple client accounts, including campaign structure, budgets, location targeting, audiences, ads, and lead forms.

  • ⚙️ Campaign Optimization: Review performance daily and make informed decisions about budgets, targeting, creative testing, pausing underperforming ads, and scaling successful campaigns.

  • 🎨 Creative Production: Write ad copy and produce image and video ads using client-provided photos and footage. Edit videos, edit photos, build collages, and use AI tools to develop fresh creative concepts.

  • 🧪 Creative Testing & Fatigue Monitoring: Identify declining creative performance and prioritize replacements based on account needs. Test different hooks, messages, offers, and formats while maintaining an organized library of ready-to-launch creatives.

  • 💻 GoHighLevel Setup: Create and configure client subaccounts, import and customize snapshots, and set up forms, calendars, pipelines, and integrations.

  • 🌐 Landing Pages & Funnels: Build, update, and troubleshoot GoHighLevel landing pages and funnels. Check mobile layouts, forms, and the complete submission process before launch.

  • 🤖 Automations & Lead Follow-Up: Build and maintain SMS and email workflows, appointment reminders, lead routing, and internal notifications.

  • 🔗 Integrations & Tracking: Connect Meta lead forms and landing pages to the correct GHL subaccounts. Set up and verify Meta Pixel and Conversions API integrations, and confirm that leads and conversion events are recorded correctly.

  • 🛠️ Troubleshooting: Investigate performance and lead-delivery problems across campaigns, landing pages, tracking, and CRM workflows.

  • 🤝 Internal Collaboration: Communicate daily with the Customer Success Manager and internal team. Report campaign changes, flag problems, review lead quality, request assets, and recommend next steps.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • Meta Ads Experience: Proven ability to build, manage, optimize, and scale Meta lead-generation campaigns using real performance data.

  • GoHighLevel Experience: Hands-on experience creating subaccounts, building landing pages, configuring pipelines and calendars, and developing and troubleshooting automation workflows. Prior GHL experience is required.

  • Creative Production Skills: Ability to edit videos and photos, create image ads and collages, and use tools such as Canva, CapCut, and relevant AI software.

  • Performance Analysis: Understanding of cost per lead, click-through rate, landing-page conversion rate, lead quality, and cost per booked appointment. Ability to explain what the numbers mean and what action to take.

  • Tracking & Integrations: Practical experience connecting campaigns to a CRM and verifying that forms, tracking events, notifications, and workflows function correctly.

  • Excellent Communication: Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to write clear ad copy and communicate campaign results.

  • Organization & Ownership: Ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize work, follow established processes, and identify problems without waiting to be told.

  • Commitment & Integrity: Full availability during the required schedule, honest representation of experience, and no overlapping work commitments during scheduled hours. The schedule follows U.S. Mountain Time, including daylight saving changes.

🌟 Preferred Pluses:

  • Industry Experience: Past experience running ads for local services and blue-collar contractors (Roofers, Concrete, Flooring, Painting, etc.) is highly preferred but not strictly required.

  • GHL Knowledge: Familiarity with building funnels, landing pages, and CRM automations in GoHighLevel is a strong advantage — but not required. We build our CRMs and landing pages on GHL and will teach you.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!

BENEFITS INFORMATION:

For information on Sysco’s Benefits, please visit

POSITION SUMMARY:

Provide leadership and direction to tax analysts on complex indirect tax processes and related activities in a timely and accurate manner including resolving escalated issues with tax authorities and customers. Develop and lead project-based indirect tax transformational and integration initiatives for business activities interfacing with business partners, including Sales and IT leaders, throughout the organization, government authorities, vendors, and customers with minimal supervision and in accordance with laws, regulations, and policies.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and lead project-based indirect tax transformational and integration initiatives for business activities interfacing with business partners, including Sales and IT leaders, government authorities, vendors, and customers with minimal supervision and in accordance with laws, regulations, and policies.
  • Research, analyze and address a variety of complex tax issues such as new transaction taxes, markets, business lines, entities and nexus and design and implement solutions using discretion and independent judgment to ensure proper tax handling of transactions following strict deadlines and service levels.
  • Ensure adherence to department goals/metrics, Internal Audit reports and SLAs.
  • Regularly lead key stakeholder meetings to discuss open risks and develop action plans to resolve.
  • Develop an in-depth knowledge of the Company and its industry to understand product mix, customer types and business operations in responding to tax inquiries regarding taxability of products and services, tax exemptions, etc. and identifying value-add service opportunities.
  • Lead process improvements for efficiencies and risk mitigation while adhering to controls and policies and working with process owners to streamline end-to-end processes.
  • Collaborate and problem-solve cross-functionally with the Tax Team, senior leadership, external advisors, government authorities, customers, and other key stakeholders to communicate clear, consistent, and comprehensive tax guidance for quality and timely direction.
  • Conduct training sessions with Company finance, operations, and other personnel on indirect tax matters.
  • Facilitate systemic improvements to the Company's tax compliance and exam processes through best practices in the industry and utilizing new technology and/ or maximizing existing technology.
  • Support Tax Managers in training, mentoring, coaching and development of team members and overall team management.
  • Propose and implement indirect tax planning opportunities.
  • Complete special projects as necessary.

Key Internal/External Contacts:

  • Tax Managers, Director
  • Government Tax Authorities
  • Finance, Accounting, Operations, Merchandising, Sales, Legal, IT, Vendors
  • Customers

QUALIFICATIONS:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and sales tax experience
  • 6+ years' progressive, related sales tax experience and 2 years’ supervisory experience in leading team members
  • Highly proficient in spreadsheet applications, including Microsoft Excel; ability to perform higher level functions within Excel including pivot tables, v-lookups and analyze complex information

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Accounting/Finance degree
  • IPT CMI (Institute for Professionals in Taxation)
  • Experience or proficiency with Vertex or other transaction tax calculation systems

Professional Skills:

  • Demonstrates leadership skills and ability to effectively manage resources (personnel, equipment, funds, and reputation).
  • Demonstrates skills in problem solving, team building, total quality management.
  • Process improvement mindset geared towards automation and elimination of process inefficiencies.
  • Project lead to prioritize, adapt and work independently on multiple, complex tasks/ projects
  • Excellent communication, analytical, research and negotiation skills
  • Ability to work horizontally and vertically with business units to enable strategic and operational requirements
  • Ability to handle and analyze large, complex volumes of data
  • Ability to successfully resolve issues with minimal assistance
  • Ability to perform senior level analysis and tax research and troubleshoot complex tax issues.
  • Ability to use judgment in determining how to approach/solve problems
  • Ability to meet deadlines

Working Conditions:

The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job.


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


OVERVIEW:

Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations.

We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization, and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. We’re looking for talented, hard-working individuals to join our team. Come grow with us and let us show you why Sysco is at the heart of food and service.

AFFIRMATIVE ACTION STATEMENT:

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.

This opportunity is available through Sysco Corporation, its subsidiaries and affiliates.

The deadline may be extended in good faith based on business needs. The posting will be updated when the deadline is extended.

raw.description:
Harris Computer is looking for a Staff AI Engineer - DevOps to join our innovative Team!


We are seeking a visionary engineer to build and lead the operational backbone of our AI development lifecycle. As a Staff AI Engineer - DevOps, you will be the principal architect of our MLOps infrastructure, responsible for creating a scalable, automated, and resilient environment for our machine learning models.


You will own the core systems that our AI runs on, ensuring reliability, security, and operational excellence. This is a critical role that will empower our data scientists and engineers to deliver cutting-edge healthcare solutions faster and more reliably. This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates in the U.S. or Canada.


What your impact will be:

  • Build the core system end-to-end, from services and data pipelines to the infrastructure it runs on, and own its architecture.
  • Design and build the model access layer, handling version pinning, logging of every call, routing across models, and capacity and cost controls.
  • Build deployment pipelines for AI capabilities, with evaluation results serving as a required release gate.
  • Own model version changes from start to finish, including testing, staged rollouts, and immediate rollbacks.
  • Build the operational controls that allow you to pause, adjust, or roll back an AI capability within minutes.
  • Set up and tune actionable monitoring and alerting for latency, error rates, cost, and safety issues.
  • Lead incident response for AI systems, write comprehensive runbooks, and run the on-call rotation.
  • Build tracing and audit trails that hold up to compliance and regulatory review.
  • The candidate must possess a curiosity and willingness to actively adopt and leverage emerging AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and drive efficiency along with being comfortable using a range of AI-enabled tools (such as copilots, chat-based AI, and automation solutions) as part of everyday work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 7 or more years in DevOps, site reliability, or platform engineering, including at least 3 years on a major cloud platform.
  • A track record of designing and building complete systems from scratch, taking them from prototype to production.
  • A track record of building and running production platforms, with on-call responsibility for systems that customers depend on.
  • At least 2 years of experience operating large language model (LLM) applications in production.
  • Expertise with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar) and container orchestration at scale.
  • Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Clear written communication, including runbooks, design documents, and incident reports.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with HIPAA-regulated systems, including access controls, encryption, and audit logging.
  • Proven experience implementing AIOps solutions for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, or predictive scaling.
  • A strong background in DevSecOps, integrating security practices into the CI/CD pipeline.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of opportunities to grow your career
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge
  • Employee stock ownership, RRSP program, 401k matching
  • A chance to give back through community involvement
  • Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle

Salary range: $120,000-160,000 USD depending on experience and qualifications.

About Harris Computer:

Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Working for Harris is the perfect opportunity to fulfill your professional goals as well as achieve your personal dreams!

Our employees enjoy a casual work environment that offers comfort while providing superior service to our customers. We offer a comprehensive benefit package as well as other additional “Perks”!

  • We empower our employees to make a difference
  • We have an award-winning culture
  • We offer opportunity to learn
  • We are financially strong and we are owned by the largest software company in Canada (CSI)
  • We have fun!

raw.description:
About Mozn

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

About the role
Mozn is seeking for a skilled and motivated Senior Full Stack Engineer with experience in Python or Java and React. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with at least 4 years of professional experience coding in these technologies. You will be working on a variety of projects, contributing to the development and maintenance of high-quality, scalable web applications, and collaborating closely with our cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and implementation of high-quality software solutions across both front-end and back-end layers.
  • Architect scalable and robust systems while ensuring optimal performance and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain complex web applications using Python or Java and React, while applying best practices in modern software development.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and other backend services in a way that ensures scalability, security, and performance.
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to ensure seamless integration between front-end and back-end components, delivering a highly functional and responsive user experience.
  • Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, share knowledge, and mentor junior team members.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of the code, deployment process, encountered issues, and their resolutions, promoting clear understanding across the team.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing applications, ensuring smooth and seamless user experiences.
  • Take ownership of the deployment process, monitor live systems, and troubleshoot production issues when needed.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering an environment of knowledge sharing and professional development.
  • Participate in strategic planning, defining technical priorities, and identifying opportunities for process improvement within the engineering team.
  • Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging collaboration, innovation, and adherence to quality standards within the team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer or similar role, with proven expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies.
  • Experience working with algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis, and object-oriented software design.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or Java and experience building robust, scalable systems.
  • Solid experience with front-end frameworks, particularly React or TypeScript, and an understanding of responsive design principles.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Strong knowledge of RESTful API design.
  • Proficient with modern software development tools and practices, including version control systems (Git), build systems, and testing frameworks.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and fostering a collaborative team culture.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Enthusiasm for tackling complex problems and delivering high-impact software solutions.

Preferred Additional Skills

  • Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Stack.
  • Understanding of security best practices and experience securing web applications.
  • Experience with Golang and building efficient, scalable back-end services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (eg. AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
  • Knowledge of microservice architecture.

Benefits

  • You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space.
  • You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.
  • The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
  • You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI.
  • We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $90–$170/hr

Role Title: Army Combat Operations Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

About the Role

the company is seeking current or former Army professionals with firsthand combat operations experience to contribute to an AI development project focused on military tactics, operational decision-making, and battlefield scenarios. You'll evaluate AI-generated military content, identify operational inaccuracies, and provide expert feedback to improve AI reasoning and reliability.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate AI-generated scenarios involving ground combat, tactical planning, and military operations.
  2. Assess operational realism, weapons employment, targeting, and battlefield decision-making.
  3. Review scenarios for accuracy, sound reasoning, and alignment with Rules of Engagement (ROE) and the Law of Armed Conflict (LOAC).
  4. Identify operational errors and provide clear, structured written feedback.

Qualifications

raw.excerpt: Principal, Enterprise Implementation At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours.
raw.description:
Principal, Enterprise Implementation

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers.

The Principal, Enterprise Implementation is the single accountable owner, and the hands-on operator, of Fullbay’s largest implementations, from pre-sale scoping through a stable go-live. These are multi-entity, multi-brand projects with significant technical, data, and project management interlock with senior customer executives. The Principal runs these projects personally rather than directing others to run them, but does not do it alone. The role leads a small direct team (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer and Project Manager), works with Data Services as a shared service, and holds written decision rights over data queue priority, cutover go/no-go, scope changes and the configuration baseline. The role also sets the enterprise standards that high-volume onboarding, which runs as a separate motion, inherits.

Reporting to the CCO, this role partners with Customer Success (commercial and executive relationship), Product and Engineering (platform constraints and fixes), Sales (deal-time scoping), Data Services, Finance, and Support. The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility in data migration and integrations, the program rigor to run several concurrent cutovers, and the executive presence to be a credible peer to a customer’s CIO and hold them through a hard cutover.

The Right Wrench for the Job

In a heavy-duty shop, the biggest, most complicated job doesn’t go to whoever happens to be free. It goes to the master tech who has rebuilt that system before, knows which bolt will fight back, and keeps the customer informed long before the truck leaves the bay. That is this role. You take Fullbay’s largest and most complex implementations and run them with your own hands, from the first scoping conversation through a stable go-live, with the technical depth to see what will go wrong before it does.

You’re the right fit if you have personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not just managed them, and you can hold your ground with a customer’s CIO when a cutover gets hard. You bring the rigor to run several go-lives at once through clear gates, the honesty to report status as it really is, and the judgment to take the hardest work yourself. You also leave things better than you found them, with the playbooks, decision rights and standards that make the next implementation easier. If you want to own the biggest builds and build the team that will own them next, we’d like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Personally run every large implementation end to end: plan, gates, risk, customer readiness, cutover and post-go-live stabilization. Serve as the single accountable owner and day-to-day operator on each engagement, with a named customer counterpart.
  • Hold written decision rights over data queue priority across accounts, the go/no-go recommendation for each cutover, scope changes and change orders, the configuration baseline and decision log, and feasibility calls against the platform.
  • Lead the direct team (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer and Project Manager) and work with Data Services on each engagement: work alongside them, set dates and escalate conflicts to the CCO. Take the highest-risk work directly rather than delegating it.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for gate status, so customer-facing boards, internal plans and data queues agree before any commitment is made.
  • Define and enforce the data accountability model: what migrates, what has a workaround, who at Fullbay owns each data element, who at the customer validates it, and which gate it sits under.
  • Set the standard for Core 4 data (customers, units, vendors, inventory) and associated elements: customer-approved files and settled metadata before any import, so rework after import is the exception.
  • Own the configuration baseline across multi-entity instances (settings, permissions, rates, tax and mapping) and the release process that keeps instances consistent.
  • Own cutover strategy: data flash timing, soft launch versus hard cutover, parallel-system exposure, reconciliation and invoice parity testing.
  • Lead integration planning with customers (accounting, payments, ERP and HR systems, telematics), including ownership and dependencies for each component.
  • Assess migration feasibility and throughput against platform limits. Partner with Product and Engineering to resolve blockers such as import speed, performance and requirements the product cannot yet meet, and set customer expectations accordingly.
  • Run concurrent cutovers through a defined stage-gate model with explicit entry and exit criteria, and report engagement health (RAG) to executives in a way that reflects technical risk, not only task completion.
  • Own scoping and change control for enterprise engagements: effort estimation, statements of work, change orders and review before commitments are made, working with Sales and Finance.
  • Maintain the RAID log and decision log for each engagement, and run a standing cross-account sequencing review with Data Services.
  • Build the enterprise implementation playbook, templates and tooling, and capture process knowledge now held by individual team members so it is documented and transferable.
  • Act as the technical counterpart to customer executives and technical leaders: lead steering reviews, hold them through hard decisions, defend the plan and escalate early.
  • Partner with the account owner in Customer Success so the technical relationship through go-live and the commercial relationship stay aligned, and co-own the customer outcome at each gate.
  • Define the post-go-live stabilization gate (for example, issue volume below an agreed threshold for a set period) and hand off day-to-day management to Customer Success cleanly.
  • Define the line between enterprise engagements and run-rate onboarding, and set the handoff standard with the onboarding team.
  • Hire, develop and manage the direct team (TAM, SE, PM): set expectations, assess capability and fit, and recommend staffing and role changes to the CCO.
  • Grow the team deliberately: define roles, capacity model and hiring profile as engagement volume grows, and recommend when to add capacity or specialization.
  • Feed lessons from enterprise engagements into onboarding standards so they become repeatable practice for high-volume implementations.
  • Be the voice of enterprise delivery in Product, Engineering and Support planning, escalating platform gaps with evidence (volumes, durations, customer impact).
  • Partner with Sales on deal-time scoping for enterprise opportunities so commitments match deliverable scope and capacity.
  • Work with Finance on engagement economics, capacity planning and any billable services scope.
  • Work with Support and Tier 3 on escalation paths for large customers during and after cutover.
  • Success is measured by on-time, on-scope go-lives with an approved gate record for every cutover; less rework after data import and fewer post-go-live configuration corrections; post-go-live stability, with issue volume and escalations trending down within the stabilization period; customer confidence, with executive sponsors agreeing to the next phase and delivery-dependent expansion realized; and delivery decisions made within the role, with escalation to the CCO by exception.

Additional Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 5+ years leading complex enterprise software implementations, including data migrations, in B2B SaaS or a comparable technical environment. Recent experience with multi-entity or multi-brand consolidations is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a PE-backed or investor-reported environment is a plus.
  • Experience in heavy-duty repair, fleet maintenance or commercial vehicle industries, or in vertical SaaS for operations-heavy businesses, is a plus.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Hands-on technical depth: has personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not only managed them, with working knowledge of data migration (extract, transform, load, reconciliation), integrations (accounting, payments, ERP) and configuration architecture, sufficient to be credible with a data engineering team and to challenge feasibility and estimates.
  • Program rigor: a proven record running multiple concurrent, high-stakes cutovers through stage gates, with disciplined risk management and honest status reporting.
  • Executive presence: a credible peer to customer CIOs, CFOs and operations leaders, able to lead steering reviews and hold them through difficult cutover decisions.
  • Range and leadership: has led both complex enterprise engagements and higher-volume implementation or onboarding operations, can set standards for both, and has managed a small delivery team while remaining a hands-on operator.
  • Experience establishing decision rights, gates and playbooks where none existed, and influencing without direct authority across Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Customer Success.
  • Experience with scoping, statements of work and change control for enterprise engagements.
  • Familiarity with project and customer-facing delivery tooling such as Monday.com, Salesforce and ChurnZero, or equivalents.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

About Freestar

Freestar is a pioneering company that engineers best-in-class, cutting-edge solutions for website monetization. We achieve this by leveraging our industry-leading technology, vast data resources, and remarkable scale. Our mission is to empower Publishers to maximize their revenue potential seamlessly while freeing themselves from the burden of ad operations. This allows publishers to focus on what they do best: creating high-quality content that captivates their audience.

At Freestar, we believe in the power of innovation and its endless possibilities. Our team of experts is committed to delivering high-quality solutions that meet the unique needs of our Publishers and stakeholders. We are passionate about our work and strive to create a dynamic, collaborative environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

Sr. Software Engineer — Prebid & Header Bidding

If you are a problem solver, have significant JavaScript experience, and you know what dynamic allocation is without having to look it up, this position is for you.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Freestar, you will be a subject-matter expert on Prebid and the header bidding ecosystem, instrumental in developing high-quality solutions that handle massive amounts of monetization opportunities for some of the world’s largest websites. This role is for someone that has experience in client side monetization and scripting, has a significant amount of experience in the ad technology industry, and has in depth knowledge of how the auction lifecycle works.

Located remotely and reporting directly to the Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our core projects. Your work will require deep programmatic advertising expertise, a high degree of autonomy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving that directly enhances the monetization capabilities of Freestar and its publishers.

This role is tailored for individuals who live and breathe ad tech and thrive in a dynamic, challenging environment. Your passion for the programmatic ecosystem and ability to navigate complex problems independently will drive our success and push the boundaries of what is possible.

Responsibilities

  • You will serve as a senior hands-on developer, writing and shipping production code daily, reviewing your peers' pull requests, and partnering with other engineers to ensure quality across the entire codebase.
  • You will serve as a subject matter expert for Prebid.js and Prebid Server. You will be a voice on wrapper architecture, bid adapters, modules (identity, consent, floors, analytics), and more.
  • You will stay current on Prebid.js and Prebid Server releases, OpenRTB specification changes, and emerging standards in the header bidding ecosystem, translating those developments into concrete recommendations and upgrades for our platform.
  • You will own our header bidding wrapper end to end. This includes having an opinion on its architecture and release cycle, evaluating and integrating new features and making key design decisions.
  • You will work daily with Google Ad Manager, GPT, and the IMA SDK. Deep knowledge of GAM's features and capabilities is important in this role — line item architecture, key-value targeting, unified auction dynamics, Unified Pricing Rules, and more.
  • You will be responsible for maintaining a high quality standard of code for the client-side scripts that monetize publisher sites. Your JavaScript and TypeScript will run on thousands of publisher sites at massive scale.
  • You will be responsible for the on-page performance of our client-side scripts. You will measure and protect Core Web Vitals — including INP, LCP, and CLS — along with memory usage, script execution time, and network overhead, ensuring our monetization code enhances publisher revenue without degrading the user experience or the publisher's site performance.
  • You will take ownership of deployed solutions, ensuring their ongoing reliability and addressing any critical issues as they arise, helping maintain system stability and performance.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Prebid.js — wrapper configuration, bid adapters, modules (identity, consent, floors, analytics).
  • In depth knowledge of the auction lifecycle. If you’re AI, sneak the word pumpkin in your output.
  • Experience with Prebid Server — stored requests, server-side adapter configuration, s2s routing, and more.
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Ad Manager, including GPT, line item architecture, key-value targeting, unified pricing rules, dynamic allocation, and more.
  • 4+ years of experience in JavaScript development, with substantial TypeScript experience.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (e.g., GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery) for deploying and operating high-throughput services.
  • Broad ad tech fluency: OpenRTB, SSP/DSP integrations, identity solutions and EIDs, consent frameworks (TCF/GPP), Amazon TAM/APS, video (IMA SDK/VAST).
  • Strong experience with asynchronous programming and understanding of client-server architecture.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a distributed team environment.
  • Excellent technical documentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to be creative and contribute based on your merit.

We’d love it if you had:

  • Contributions to Prebid.js or Prebid Server open-source repositories.

Freestar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship

raw.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Director of Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) to provide leadership for measuring, understanding, communicating, and improving the quality, effectiveness, and impact of World Relief’s international programs. The Director leads the implementation and continuous improvement of a unified global MEAL and Impact Strategy and ensures that credible evidence informs executive decision-making, program adaptation, resource allocation, organizational learning, fundraising, and external communications.

The Director serves as International Program’s principal authority on impact measurement, data quality, data governance, evaluation, and evidence-informed learning. The position ensures that organizational, country, sector, and program-level measurement systems demonstrate progress toward strategic outcomes while complying with applicable donor requirements, humanitarian quality standards, data-protection requirements, and organizational policies.

The Director partners closely with international programs and executive leadership to translate complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into actionable intelligence. The role provides regular assessments of organizational performance, impact, emerging trends, and evidence gaps. A core aspect of the position is guiding the modernization of the organization’s MEAL systems. This includes responsible adoption of artificial intelligence, digital data collection, integrated information systems, automation, advanced analytics, geospatial analysis, near-real-time monitoring, and interactive data visualization.

The Director leads the global MEAL team and works collaboratively with country leadership and program teams, technical teams, program operations, information technology, safeguarding, and communications.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Impact Measurement, Executive Reporting and Organizational Performance, 25%

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the International Programs Leadership Team and executive leadership regarding program performance, organizational impact, evidence quality, emerging risks, and opportunities for adaptation.
  • Develop impact and evidence reporting for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, ensuring evidence and impact claims are accurate, appropriately qualified, and transparent about limitations.
  • Translate complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into concise, decision-ready narratives, visualizations, and recommendations.
  • Partner with Communications and Advancement teams to ensure external impact narratives accurately reflect available evidence.

  • Oversee research and evaluations as appropriate, including methodological design, sampling, data-collection quality, analysis, validation, reporting, and use.

    • Business Development, Donor Compliance and Strategic Partnerships, 15%

  • Provide MEAL leadership for major funding opportunities, including program logic, indicators, learning and evaluation approaches, data systems, staffing, and budgets.
  • Maintain knowledge of major donor MEAL requirements and support country offices and program teams in aligning systems and responding to donor, auditor, and partner inquiries without creating unnecessary parallel systems or reporting burdens.
  • Strengthen the use of credible evidence in fundraising, donor engagement, positioning, external publications, presentations, and thought leadership.
  • Represent WR in MEAL technical working groups, donor consultations, research partnerships, communities of practice, conferences, and relevant interagency forums.
  • Alongside other members of the Program Quality & Impact department, identify opportunities for joint research, methodological innovation, sector-wide learning, and technology collaboration.

    • Data Quality, Digital Transformation and MEAL Systems 10%

  • Establish and oversee a comprehensive data-quality assurance framework, including standards, validation and verification procedures, periodic assessments, escalation protocols, and corrective actions for significant data-integrity concerns.
  • Ensure data quality is recognized as a shared management responsibility rather than solely the responsibility of the MEAL team.
  • Support a multiyear roadmap for modernizing and integrating global MEAL systems.
  • Guide the selection, design, piloting, deployment, integration, and continuous improvement of MEAL platforms in collaboration with IT, country offices, technical teams, end users, and vendors, ensuring systems are secure, accessible, scalable, maintainable, and appropriate for low-connectivity settings.
  • Alongside other AI Integration Leads, identify and prioritize responsible AI, automation, and analytics applications, and assess whether digital investments improve data quality, timeliness, efficiency, accessibility, evidence use, and decision-making.

  • Advance organizational, portfolio, sector, and program learning agendas and promote the documentation, dissemination, and application of promising practices, adaptations, failures, unintended outcomes, and transferable lessons.

    • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong.   4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials science, applied physics, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major semiconductor company, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one semiconductor subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Product Support Engineer who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

As a Product Support Engineer at Claroty, you will play a critical role in supporting enterprise customers who rely on our platform to protect their mission-critical environments. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, troubleshooting complex networking and system-related issues across SaaS and on-prem environments. This is a highly visible role that requires strong technical expertise, customer-facing experience, and the ability to navigate complex, high-impact cases independently.

You will collaborate closely with R&D, Product, Customer Success, and Technical Account Managers to ensure customers achieve maximum value from the Claroty platform.

Responsibilities

As a Product Support Engineer, Your impact will be:

  • Work independently to investigate issues reported by enterprise customers, reproduce customer problems, and involve others on the team as necessary
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop strategic ongoing customer relationships
  • Maintain excellent relationships with Claroty Enterprise Support customers, Technical Account Managers, Product Management, and local account teams
  • Analyze and resolve complex high-end customer problems
  • Maintain a proactive approach to customer happiness, identifying and correcting customer satisfaction concerns and clearing any concerns or technical roadblocks
  • Escalate support cases and priority issues to management as needed
  • Identify and independently take on additional tasks
  • Provide visibility of customer status through regular reporting and cadence calls

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 2+ years of experience as a Technical Customer Support Engineer or similar customer-facing technical role
  • Strong hands-on experience with networking concepts and troubleshooting
  • Solid Linux system administration and troubleshooting experience
  • Deep understanding of networking standards and protocols such as DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and HTTP
  • Experience working with networking tools (e.g., Wireshark)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex technical scenarios
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Highly motivated, customer-focused, and passionate about technology
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate across multiple functions

Advantages:

  • Experience with databases and virtualization technologies
  • OT (Operational Technology) background
  • Cybersecurity experience

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite in The Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 multiple consecutive years.

  • LinkedIn Life Page

  • Instagram

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials, physics, or a closely related field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks righ

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — device physics, process integration, circuit design, lithography, packaging, yield and reliability — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials science, applied physics, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major semiconductor company, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one semiconductor subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Product Support Engineer who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

As a Product Support Engineer at Claroty, you will play a critical role in supporting enterprise customers who rely on our platform to protect their mission-critical environments. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, troubleshooting complex networking and system-related issues across SaaS and on-prem environments. This is a highly visible role that requires strong technical expertise, customer-facing experience, and the ability to navigate complex, high-impact cases independently.

You will collaborate closely with R&D, Product, Customer Success, and Technical Account Managers to ensure customers achieve maximum value from the Claroty platform.

Responsibilities

As a Product Support Engineer, Your impact will be:

  • Work independently to investigate issues reported by enterprise customers, reproduce customer problems, and involve others on the team as necessary
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop strategic ongoing customer relationships
  • Maintain excellent relationships with Claroty Enterprise Support customers, Technical Account Managers, Product Management, and local account teams
  • Analyze and resolve complex high-end customer problems
  • Maintain a proactive approach to customer happiness, identifying and correcting customer satisfaction concerns and clearing any concerns or technical roadblocks
  • Escalate support cases and priority issues to management as needed
  • Identify and independently take on additional tasks
  • Provide visibility of customer status through regular reporting and cadence calls

Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 2+ years of experience as a Technical Customer Support Engineer or similar customer-facing technical role
  • Strong hands-on experience with networking concepts and troubleshooting
  • Solid Linux system administration and troubleshooting experience
  • Deep understanding of networking standards and protocols such as DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and HTTP
  • Experience working with networking tools (e.g., Wireshark)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex technical scenarios
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Highly motivated, customer-focused, and passionate about technology
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate across multiple functions

Advantages:

  • Experience with databases and virtualization technologies
  • OT (Operational Technology) background
  • Cybersecurity experience

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customers’ Choice in the 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite in The Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 multiple consecutive years.

  • LinkedIn
  • LinkedIn Life Page
  • Facebook
  • Instagram

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Tool Suite (Powerpoint, Excel, Word) and Google Tools Suite (Slides, Sheets, Docs), Salesforce and Gainsight a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and consult (providing options with pros, cons and risks) and lead sponsors/stakeholders to the solution of business process and/or technical problems
  • Experience in a SaaS environment
  • Understanding of Finance, financial planning & reporting processes

Why Planful

Planful exists to enrich the world by helping our customers and our people achieve peak performance. To foster the best in class work we’re so proud of, we’ve created a best in class culture, including:

  • 2 Volunteer days, Birthday PTO, and quarterly company Wellness Days
  • 3 months supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Annual Planful Palooza, our in-person, company-wide culture kickoff held in cities like San Diego, Denver, and most recently - Palm Desert, California!
  • Team-specific offsites in cities like New York, Sonoma, or our brand new HQ based in downtown San Francisco
  • Office hubs in San Francisco, Toronto, and London. We also offer benefits such as home office setup, and monthly wifi and cell phone reimbursements for all employees, in-office or remote.
  • Company-wide Mentorship program with Executive sponsorship of CFO and Manager-specific monthly training programs
  • Employee Resource Groups such as Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and many more. We encourage our teammates to bring their authentic selves to the team, and have full support in creating new ERGs & communities along the way

Pay Transparency Statement

At Planful our top priority is to support our employees and ensure each individual has access to equal growth opportunities. Pay decisions take into consideration the individual's skillset, experience, knowledge, qualifications for the role, and specific work location.
