  • Establish and mature data ownership and stewardship practices, including identification and onboarding of data owners, data stewards, and data domain leads across business and technology organizations.
  • Lead development and implementation of data governance policies, standards, processes, and controls addressing areas such as data quality, metadata, business definitions, data classification, access, security, retention, and data sharing.
  • Integrate data governance into the design and implementation of an enterprise data warehouse and broader modern data platform, ensuring governance requirements are incorporated into data ingestion, transformation, modeling, reporting, and operational processes.
  • Partner with business and technical teams to establish and maintain enterprise data domains, critical data elements, business terms, data definitions, data lineage, and metadata to improve consistency and trust in enterprise data.
  • Define and operationalize data quality management practices, including data quality rules, issue identification and remediation, monitoring, ownership, escalation, and reporting.
  • Facilitate governance working sessions and decision-making with stakeholders across programs, business functions, IT, privacy, security, and agency leadership.
  • Support requirements gathering and source-data assessment activities by helping teams understand data ownership, definitions, lineage, quality, usage, sensitivity, and authoritative sources as data is migrated or integrated into the enterprise data warehouse.
  • Develop practical governance artifacts including data governance charters, RACI matrices, stewardship guides, data domain inventories, business glossaries, data standards, issue-management processes, playbooks, and governance dashboards.
  • Support organizational adoption of the new governance model through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and development of reusable tools and guidance.
  • Partner with client stakeholders to align warehousing work with data governance practices, access controls, and operational support models.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university.
  • Based on our contractual obligations, candidate must be located within the United States and US Citizen.
  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST".
  • Minimum FIVE (5) years of overall work experience.
  • Experience delivering technical solutions and programs to public sector organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading data governance initiatives or workstreams, including development or implementation of data governance operating models, policies, processes, standards, and organizational roles.
  • Strong knowledge of core data governance concepts and practices, including data ownership and stewardship, data domains, metadata management, business glossaries, data lineage, data quality, master/reference data, data classification, privacy, security, and access controls.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data modernization programs, preferably involving an enterprise data warehouse, cloud data platform, lakehouse, data integration, or analytics modernization.
  • Experience managing a project workstream, including planning work, managing deliverables and dependencies, supervising team members, facilitating client decisions, and communicating risks and status to leadership.
  • Strong communication skills to bridge technical and business worlds.
  • During peak periods, 25% travel to the client site (i.e. during requirements gathering, UAT, implementation/go live, etc.).

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Experience leading data governance or data modernization initiatives for state or local government agencies, particularly enterprise or cross-program initiatives.
  • Familiarity with modern enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Microsoft Fabric and an understanding of how governance integrates with modern cloud data architectures.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance, catalog, quality, or privacy technologies such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Informatica, OneTrust, or similar platforms.
  • Experience establishing data catalogs, business glossaries, metadata repositories, data lineage, data quality scorecards, or stewardship workflows.
  • Experience supporting business development including RFP/RFQ/RFI responses involving data science / analytics.

Overview:
We are looking for a Test Leader to join the Test Centre of a leading international insurance and financial services group, supporting testing services for its French operations. The role contributes to the Test Strategy, Master Test Plan and test design, and ensures the execution of test campaigns, the follow-up of test analysts and reporting to project stakeholders. You will report directly to the Test Centre Team Leader, working in Agile projects based in Lisbon and you will help ensure the functional quality of delivered increments and features.

What will you do?

  • Contribute to the Test Strategy, Master Test Plan and test design activities;
  • Contribute to the design of Business Analyst tests within projects, respecting project deliverables and the standards in place;
  • Input test subjects into the dedicated testing tools according to defined standards;
  • Ensure the elaboration, validation and communication of all testing deliverables within scope;
  • Contribute to the implementation and execution of test campaigns, including their updates;
  • Execute tests within the assigned scope of responsibility and record the results in the dedicated testing tools;
  • Guarantee the correct prioritisation of tests and contribute to the organisation of Business Analyst knowledge;
  • Follow up the work of test analysts and report to project stakeholders;
  • Ensure the functional quality of increments and delivered features;
  • Ensure the testability of Backlog items and features to be delivered;
  • Provide the information required for Go/No Go decisions;
  • Identify, register, prioritise and validate the correction of project anomalies;
  • Report risks regarding project quality or delivery timelines;
  • Provide regular feedback to the Test Manager and management regarding project progress;
  • Create test reports to communicate with project stakeholders;
  • Manage project committees related to test progress and defect follow-up;
  • Contribute to the preparation of final reports and testing procedures;
  • Contribute to the technical and methodological excellence of testing activities.

What are we looking for?

  • Degree in Informatics, Computer Science or related areas;
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in testing activities;
  • Experience in the environment of the service: 0 to 2 years;
  • Knowledge of test methodology principles and vocabulary (ISTQB);
  • Experience creating Test Strategies and Test Schedules;
  • Experience managing one or more software testers;
  • Experience working within Agile environments;
  • Knowledge of Octane, JIRA and Confluence;
  • Knowledge of API testing;
  • Knowledge of SQL language;
  • Experience in risk identification, management and follow-up;
  • Experience testing applications related to Life Insurance or Banking products (desirable);
  • Experience with applications such as ORION, HERA, Wynsure and GLIS is considered an advantage;
  • Coordination and motivation skills;
  • Systematic, critical and logical thinking, with good summarisation capabilities;
  • Strong commitment and sense of accountability;
  • Pedagogical mindset and knowledge-sharing capability;
  • Customer satisfaction orientation and ability to deliver high-quality results;
  • Ability to manage stress and conflicts;
  • Good listening and questioning skills;
  • Good learning capabilities and adaptability to changes and evolving environments;
  • Ability to plan work ahead and prioritise workload;
  • Ability to travel outside Portugal;
  • Willingness and ability to work outside normal office hours in exceptional circumstances;
  • Fluent in French (mandatory);
  • Professional level of English.

What can you expect from us?

  • A permanent job contract for a long term project;
  • Tech equipment + SIM Card + personal smartphone;
  • Health and Life Insurance;
  • Social events and team buildings;
  • The commitment of letting you grow with us, and be rewarded accordingly;

  • Training in the latest technologies;

Become a part of our caring community

Humana is recruiting a Clinical Strategy Lead within Humana’s Medicare Advantage (MA) business and Clinical Strategy/Innovation team. This individual will identify and execute clinical priorities that improve outcomes, control costs, and enhance member experience. The role focuses on complex initiatives across clinical specialties and care delivery innovations to deliver trend and enterprise value. The Clinical Strategy team employs a rigorous process to identify the greatest sources of value and leads multi-disciplinary teams to deploy and manage solutions. This is a remote opportunity to join a dynamic team within Humana and work on complex and diverse clinical priorities while getting experience and exposure across the enterprise.

The Clinical Strategy Lead drives clinical innovations using data and insights from internal and external sources. This individual will identify and prioritize clinical opportunities and associated solutions, working with enterprise partners to develop strategic recommendations, support execution, and assess ongoing performance. Specifically, this individual will be part of a team that leads clinical innovation and product initiatives, advancing new solutions and/or enterprise capabilities, to reduce total cost of care while improving clinical quality and member experience. Priority clinical areas could include oncology, nephrology, cardiometabolic, pulmonary, and/or other high-priority clinical conditions.


The Clinical Strategy Lead will:

  • Engage in ambiguous and complex problem solving, strategy development, solution/capabilities creation, and execution/management on specific clinical priorities for the organization.
  • Use data and insights from internal & industry experts to identify the greatest opportunities to deliver improved clinical outcomes (cost, quality, and experience) for Humana’s MA members.
  • Work directly with enterprise business partners (clinical, finance, contracting, operations, markets, vendors) to create the strategic plan and roadmap to execute and capture prioritized opportunities.
  • Lead and influence a multidisciplinary team towards shared goals, defining the discrete opportunities that are both impactful and achievable.

Key Skills and Abilities necessary for success:

  • Clinical program/product strategy & design: experience building or evaluating care pathways for high-cost chronic conditions and translating clinical evidence into solution requirements.
  • Cross-functional expertise: proven ability to effectively lead with influence across teams and a track record of success working through ambiguity to achieve desired results.
  • Financial and ROI modeling: ability to build business cases and unit economic models, working collaboratively with finance and analytics to assess solutions’ near and long-term sustainability.
  • Clinical data and metrics: Ability to define clinical KPIs and leverage analytics insights that connect directly to utilization / quality outcomes and performance improvement opportunities.
  • Critical thinking: Independent judgment and decision making on complex issues regarding job duties and related tasks.
  • Effective communication: experienced in developing and delivering persuasive presentations to all levels in the organization.


Use your skills to make an impact

Role Essentials

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 7 or more years of experience creating and driving strategy, or 4 or more years of experience in corporate strategy or management consulting experience
  • 2 or more years of project/program/product leadership experience
  • Direct experience designing, operating, or evaluating clinical programs or care pathways for complex or high-cost conditions.
  • Demonstrated ability to articulate ideas effectively in both written and oral forms
  • Demonstrated experience conducting qualitative and quantitative analysis to support business decision-making
  • Competency with Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Copilot)

Role Desirables

  • Master's degree (MBA, MHA)
  • Experience with value-based care strategy and/or operations
  • Experience in the health care industry, particularly care services/delivery and innovation
  • Prior work within Medicare Advantage

raw.description:
Baerekracht zoekt een medewerk(st)er organisatieontwikkeling en projectmanagement!

Draag jij graag bij aan een betere wereld? Dit is jouw kans om de wereld mooier te maken en mensen warm maken voor reizen te combineren met projectmanagement. Werk je graag in een zich nog ontwikkelende werkomgeving? Wil jij samen met ons projecten ontwikkelen en monitoren? Wacht jij niet af, maar pak je aan? Ben je iemand die graag mensen samenbrengt? Dan zoekt Baerekracht jou! Wij zijn een non-profit reisorganisatie gevestigd in regio Gent. Wij ontwikkelen voor, maar vooral mét de mensen in onze doelgroep (

Voor de dagelijkse gang van zaken zoeken we iemand, minste twee jaar ervaring in een coördinerende rol en bij voorkeur met ervaring in toerisme. Als medewerker organisatieontwikkeling wordt je deel van het kernteam en zorg je voor goede interne en externe communicatie. Je bent onderdeel van een lerende organisatie en kan zelf organisatie-ontwikkelprojecten aandragen en uitvoeren. Je wil graag meer leren over fondsenwerving, projectmanagement, de toeristische sector en in het bijzonder toegankelijk reizen. Je behoort zelf tot onze doelgroep of je bent bereid je in onze doelgroep in te leven. Doordat we een kleine organisatie zijn, is het werk heel afwisselend.

Tegelijkertijd zorg je ervoor dat alle projecten en onderzoeken gemonitord worden. Je overziet de planning, risico’s en budgetten. Je bent bereidt om voor deze projecten prospecties in het buitenland uit te voeren.
Je bent ook verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden van de warme contacten met sponsors.

Eens de projecten operationeel zijn ben je ook bereidt om van A tot Z boekingen ter harte te nemen en nauw contact te houden met onze reizigers.

Als medewerker organisatie- en projectontwikkeling ben je met veel dingen bezig, zowel intern als extern:

Opstartfase: oktober tot december

- Accountmanager van externe opdrachtgevers, partners en fondsencontacten.
- Mee helpen opstellen van een projectplan en begroting.

- Samenstellen van een eerste werkgroep

- Leren kennen van de doelgroep en hun behoeften o.a. onder de vorm van prospectie

Vanaf januari

- Bijhouden en controleren van begrotingen, inkoop, facturen, externe opdrachten en subsidies-administratie.
- De stroomlijning van de interne informatievoorziening.
- Monitoren van planning, risico’s en budgetten van projecten.

- Faciliteren van werkgroepen.

- Plannen, werving en selectie van accomodaties en activiteiten.
- Uitwerken van reisprogramma's en uitvoeren en opvolgen van boekingen

We heten iedereen welkom en je moet aan minimaal 7 punten voldoen:

- Je hebt een hogeschool opleiding afgerond.

- Je hebt een passie voor reizen.

- Je hebt bij voorkeur een aantal jaren ervaring met werken binnen een kleinere of dynamische organisatie bij voorkeur in de reissector.
- Je neemt iets vast van bij het begin tot iets is geïmplementeerd.
- Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de organisatie.
- Je werkt gestructureerd en overzichtelijk, maar bent ook flexibel.
- Je hebt interesse in het management van sociale / toeristische projecten.
- Je kunt af en toe buiten kantooruren werken.
- Je bent sociaal vaardig en communicatief sterk.
- Je behoort zelf tot onze doelgroep of voelt je aangetrokken om je in onze doelgroep in te leven
- Je bent alert en herkent dromen van onze reizigers en partnerorganisaties die vertaald kunnen worden naar projecten.

Er wordt bij ons hard gewerkt en er gebeurt van alles. Daarom zoeken wij een enthousiaste medewerker die:

- zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband kan werken.

- zakelijk bewustzijn heeft.

- werkzaamheden naar zich toe durft te trekken.
- oog heeft voor het welzijn van anderen.
- interesse heeft in toerisme
- affiniteit heeft met maatschappelijk werken.
- duurzaamheid belangrijk vindt.

- inclusieve sensitiviteit heeft.

We zoeken in eerste instantie iemand die 1 tot 2 dagen beschikbaarheid heeft om het project mee te lanceren en die de ambitie heeft om, van zodra dit financieel kan, deze tijdsinvestering waar nodig verder uit te breiden en een lange termijn samenwerking aan te gaan.

  • Je komt terecht in een omgeving die je nog volledig, binnen het kernteam vorm kan geven
  • Je kan mee helpen bouwen aan een betere wereld
  • Je kan mensen helpen om de transformatieve kracht van natuur en reizen voor zichzelf en hun omgeving te ontdekken

We kijken er alvast naar uit om jou te mogen leren kennen en dromen alvast van een prachtige toekomst, misschien wel samen met jou.

In afwachting van goedkeuring van subsidie (eind december) bieden we deze tewerkstelling aan als vrijwilliger met dag- en onkostenvergoeding.

We moedigen in het bijzonder mensen die tot de doelgroep behoren aan om te solliciteren.
We zien erop toe dat eventuele sollicitatiegesprekken en verdere fysieke samenwerking kunnen doorgaan in een toegankelijke werkomgeving.

Baerekracht is een non-profit organisatie die inzet op bijzondere en toegankelijke natuurbeleving door het ontwikkelen van een reisaanbod voor mensen in een rolstoel en/of verminderde mobiliteit en hun reisgezellen waarbij natuurbeleving centraal staat.

Baerekracht neemt in het toeristische domein, in Vlaanderen en in de rest van Europa, een voortrekkersrol in het onderzoek en in de ontwikkeling van een blauwdruk voor ‘bijzondere en toegankelijke natuurbeleving’. We ontwerpen en testen samen met mensen in in onze doelgroep en geven zo vorm aan boekbaar van aanbod van natuurbelevingsreizen in groen Europa.

🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance.
🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew?
  • Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.
  • Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024.
  • Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.

🧭 Navigating the position: Product Manager - Ocean Intelligence As a Product Manager at OneOcean, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering our AI-powered solutions across our existing product portfolio, spanning Human Capital Management (HCM), Technical Ship & Crew Management (TSCM) and Voyage Compliance & Performance Management.

You will be responsible for identifying where artificial intelligence and machine learning can add the greatest value to our customers and working cross-functionally to bring them to market. From predictive maintenance insights and intelligent crew management to voyage optimisation and automated compliance monitoring, you will help ensure OneOcean remains at the forefront of maritime digital innovation.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company – including engineering, data science, design, commercial and domain experts – to define and prioritise product initiatives, ensuring that we deliver innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive both customer satisfaction and financial results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the AI product roadmap across HCM, TSCM & VCPM product lines, and own the delivery prioritised AI features and capabilities within.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to embed AI and machine learning capabilities into existing OneOcean solutions, prioritising initiatives based on customer impact, technical feasibility and commercial value
  • Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate complex AI/ML concepts into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Engage directly with customers, end users and internal maritime domain experts to deeply understand workflows, pain points and opportunities where AI can drive measurable improvements
  • Champion a data-driven approach to product development, defining key metrics and success criteria for AI features and continuously measuring outcomes against them
  • Work with UX and design teams to ensure AI-powered features are intuitive, transparent and trusted by maritime professionals both on board and ashore
  • Stay abreast of emerging trends in AI, large language models, predictive analytics and maritime technology, bringing outside-in thinking to the OneOcean product strategy
  • Partner with commercial and go-to-market teams to articulate the value proposition of AI features, supporting pricing, positioning and customer communication
  • Manage the AI product lifecycle from ideation and discovery through to delivery, launch and continuous improvement
  • Ensure responsible and ethical AI practices are embedded in all product development, including data governance, model transparency, bias mitigation and regulatory compliance
  • Contribute to cross-functional planning processes including quarterly roadmap reviews, sprint planning and stakeholder alignment sessions

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager with a strong track record of delivering AI/ML-powered products or features in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment
  • Solid understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, natural language processing, predictive analytics and large language models
  • Ability to bridge the gap between technical data science teams and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex AI concepts into clear business language
  • Strong product discovery and user research skills, with experience conducting customer interviews, synthesising insights and validating hypotheses
  • Data-driven mindset with experience defining product KPIs, running experiments and making evidence-based prioritisation decisions
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams
  • Experience working within agile product development methodologies
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a willingness to operate across multiple product domains

Desirable

  • Experience working in the maritime, shipping, logistics or related regulated industry
  • Familiarity with maritime operations including crew management, planned maintenance systems, voyage planning or regulatory compliance workflows
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML tooling and platforms (e.g. Python, TensorFlow, cloud ML services such as AWS SageMaker or Azure ML)
  • Experience with responsible AI frameworks, model governance and AI ethics in a commercial product context
  • Track record of launching AI features that have driven measurable customer and business outcomes

Senior US Payroll & Tax Analyst, Assurant, India

About US: Assurant, Inc. is a global provider of risk management products and service with headquarters in Atlanta. Its businesses provide a diverse set of specialty, niche-market insurance products in the property, casualty, extended device protection, and preneed insurance sectors. The company’s main operating segments are Global Housing and Global Lifestyle. Assurant is 325 on the Fortune 500 list of the largest companies in the United States


Overview of Position

As a Senior US Payroll & Tax Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring accurate payroll processing and payroll tax compliance across the United States, Canada, and Puerto Rico. You will serve as a subject matter expert supporting a large, complex payroll environment while partnering with HR, Finance, Legal, payroll vendors, and government agencies to deliver a seamless employee experience.

In this role, you will analyze payroll data, resolve complex payroll and tax issues, support audits and reconciliations, and contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives. You will also help drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve controls, enhance compliance, and leverage technology to increase efficiency. Assurant is looking for a highly analytical professional who combines strong US payroll expertise with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional service.


Work Timing: 6:00 PM IST to 3:00 AM IST
Working Model: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Chennai and Hyderabad


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing for multi-state and multi-entity operations while maintaining compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve complex payroll, payroll tax, and employee inquiries, providing support to employees, managers, and retirees.
  • Perform payroll audits, reconciliations, variance analyses, and compliance reviews to ensure data integrity and payroll accuracy.
  • Support payroll tax activities, including tax filings, reconciliations, tax notices, year-end reporting, and compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, external vendors, auditors, and government agencies to address payroll and tax-related matters.
  • Participate in payroll system implementations, upgrades, testing, and process improvement initiatives, including automation and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Develop and maintain payroll reporting, analytics, policies, procedures, and controls that support operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience supporting US payroll operations within a large, complex multi-state organization.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in payroll tax compliance, including federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal), with the ability to effectively communicate complex payroll and tax matters to employees, leaders, vendors, and government agencies.
  • Experience performing payroll reconciliations, audits, compliance testing, and resolving payroll tax notices and agency inquiries.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Experience with payroll platforms such as Workday, ADP, UKG, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of payroll accounting principles, wage and hour laws, SOX compliance, and internal controls.
  • Experience supporting payroll system implementations, testing activities, and change management initiatives.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting global payroll operations.
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification.
  • Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, or other reporting and automation tools.
  • Experience supporting payroll transformation, process redesign, or large-scale system implementations.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or Project Management methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex payroll and tax concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, to improve reporting, analysis, and operational efficiency.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at .

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. About the role

The EAP Care Manager is a mental health professional who provides telephonic and/or live chat support to members accessing the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role delivers brief clinical assessment, crisis intervention, solution-focused support, referral coordination, and workplace consultation services. The Care Manager ensures high-quality member experience while adhering to clinical best practices, confidentiality standards, and organizational workflows.



Pay Rate:

$28-35 per hour, commensurate with experience.


Job Summary

  • Provide telephonic and/or live chat needs assessment and screening while managing an inbound EAP phone/chat queue.
  • Deliver brief, solution-focused, in-the-moment supportive interventions and psychoeducation for concerns including stress, anxiety, grief, relationship issues, and substance use.
  • Conduct risk assessments for members presenting with concerns such as: suicidal ideation; thoughts of harm to others; substance use issues; risk for abuse or violence.
  • Provide crisis intervention and stabilization, including safety planning and connection to urgent or emergent resources when indicated.
  • Explain EAP clinical and work/life benefits and provide individualized recommendations to meet each member’s needs and goals.
  • Connect members to EAP services and/or health insurance or community resources and follow up to support successful engagement and connection to services, as clinically appropriate.
  • May provide consultation and support to HR and Managers regarding employee performance concerns, crisis support, or other issues within EAP scope, while maintaining professional boundaries and confidentiality.
  • May assist with Critical Incident Response following a Disruptive Event in the workplace, providing telephonic in-the-moment support to members and/or assisting with arranging onsite or virtual counseling at the worksite.
  • Document all interactions and activities accurately and timely in the electronic case management system.
  • Adhere to ethical standards, clinical best practices, and confidentiality requirements, including HIPAA and applicable regulations.
  • Participate in individual supervision, team meetings, and case consultation.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues to ensure high-quality member care.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and availability for scheduled shifts and caseload responsibilities.
  • Complete required trainings and maintain competency in EAP protocols and procedures.
  • Participate in the EAP on-call rotation to provide after-hours coverage (evenings, weekends, and holidays), typically assigned approximately two weeks per calendar year.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or a related behavioral health or human services field.
  • Two (2) years of clinical experience, preferably in Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), crisis intervention, behavioral health assessment, care management, or brief/solution-focused counseling settings.
  • Active professional licensure in good standing (e.g., LCSW, LMSW, LPC, LMFT, LSW, or equivalent state credential.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, queue-based environment while utilizing multiple digital platforms and electronic case management systems.
  • Strong cultural competence and ability to work effectively with diverse populations across workplace settings.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to complete timely, accurate clinical documentation.

Physical Requirements:
This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.

Mental and Cognitive Requirements:
The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.

Work Environment:
This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

raw.description:
Position Overview Legence is seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to join the IT Project Management Office (PMO) and plan and deliver IT solutions and software projects that support business needs. This role leads projects through the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from initiation, requirements, and design through development, testing, release, and post-implementation support. The IT Project Manager is accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, quality, and stakeholder communication. This position works closely with business stakeholders, product owners, development and QA teams, vendors, and IT Operations to ensure successful delivery of solutions. Key Responsibilities Client & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner with business and IT stakeholders to define project objectives, business requirements, success criteria, priorities, and expectations for IT solutions and software projects. Provide project leadership and practical recommendations to sponsors, product owners, development teams, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Serve as the primary project point of contact for scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and delivery status.

Software Delivery & Project Execution

Develop and maintain project charters, work plans, roadmaps, release schedules, budgets, resource plans, backlogs, risk and issue logs, decision logs, and delivery plans using established project management methods (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) and tools. Manage projects through each SDLC phase, including requirements, design, development, testing (including user acceptance testing), release, and post-implementation support. Coordinate release planning, change management, deployment, cutover, training, and transition to operations, ensuring deliverables align with approved requirements, quality standards, security and compliance requirements, release readiness criteria, and applicable policies.

Project & Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate work across development, QA, business analysis, infrastructure, information security, IT Operations, and business teams to deliver integrated solutions. Interface with software vendors, implementation partners, contractors, and consultants throughout planning and delivery. Support vendor selection, statements of work, procurement activities, and oversight of vendor delivery as needed.

Documentation & Communication

Document project requirements, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues, lessons learned, and acceptance criteria.

Organize and lead project meetings; prepare and distribute agendas, meeting notes, status reports, action items, and executive updates. Communicate project status, risks, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, escalating issues in a timely manner.

Leadership & Resource Management

Lead cross-functional project teams and coordinate internal and external resources to deliver work within approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. Monitor resource needs, workload, milestones, and deliverables; drive accountability for commitments and follow-through.

Desired Skills and Experience Education & Credentials

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required; PMI-ACP is preferred.

Experience

Five or more years of project management experience delivering software or IT solution projects. Demonstrated experience managing projects through the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. Experience working with development teams, QA, business analysts, product owners, business stakeholders, and vendors. Hands-on experience delivering projects using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

Professional Skills

Working knowledge of the SDLC, Agile and Waterfall methodologies, and software delivery practices such as release management, testing, and change control. Ability to develop and manage project schedules, budgets, resource plans, RAID logs, release plans, and executive-level status reporting. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project or work management tools (such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, or Smartsheet).

Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, organization, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Notes

This role may require occasional travel to company locations or project sites to support project delivery.

Other duties may be assigned as needed to support project delivery and team objectives.

Base salary: $120,000-$130,000 per year. This role may be eligible for participation in discretionary bonus plan based on company and individual performance. Notes: Actual compensation will be based on skills, experience, and work location, and may vary from the posted range. Hiring bonuses (and any guaranteed year-end bonuses) are administered under Company policy and are not earned until all stated conditions are met (e.g., active employment on the payment date). This posting reflects compensation at the time of posting and may be updated.

  • Manage all areas of project management for commercial real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
  • Interface directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project, including the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & landmarks, quality control, and risk identification.

Established book of business with a primary focus on customer retention and relationship management

Identify opportunities to retain customers, address concerns, and prevent account cancellations.

Generate new business through outbound prospecting and follow-up when opportunities arise.

Manage short, transactional sales conversations with a focus on responsiveness, accuracy, and customer experience.

Process advertising orders, campaign updates, and customer requests efficiently.

Partner with internal support teams to ensure a positive customer experience and successful advertising execution.

Previous experience in inside sales, account management, customer retention, advertising sales, or business development preferred.

Experience managing customer relationships or an established book of business is a plus.

Comfortable making 50+ outbound and inbound calls per day in a high-activity, metrics-driven environment.

Confident communicating with customers, identifying needs, handling objections, and recommending solutions.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, conversations, and follow-up activities.

Comfortable balancing customer retention responsibilities with occasional new business prospecting.

Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to daily activity and performance expectations.

Comfortable learning CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

While the primary focus is on maintaining and growing existing relationships, success requires a willingness to make calls, manage activity expectations, and pursue new business when needed. Remote Work Expectations This is a fully remote position, with the expectation that employees work from their assigned, dedicated home workstation throughout their scheduled workday.

Remain at their assigned workstation and be available throughout scheduled working hours.

Use company-approved systems and technology to perform their job responsibilities.

Maintain a consistent, professional, and productive remote work environment.

This position does not offer a work-from-anywhere arrangement. Working from alternate locations, using personal devices in place of company-issued equipment, or downloading unauthorized applications onto personal devices is not permitted. Estamos formados por personas apasionadas, inquietas, cuestionadoras y audaces que nos ayudan a buscar soluciones de impacto que aceleran nuestro crecimiento. Uniendo tecnología, infraestructura, desarrollo, respeto y diversidad, construyendo relaciones significativas.

Buscamos personas que tengan brillo en los ojos ante los desafíos y que quieran ser parte de la construcción de un mundo mejor.

Tenemos el compromiso de ser una empresa inclusiva, diversa y que busca generar sentido de pertenencia para todas las personas. No toleramos ningún tipo de prejuicio y creemos que la innovación y la transformación solo ocurren en entornos de trabajo diversos y seguros. Por eso, nos preocupamos por la inclusión y la seguridad psicológica de nuestros Titanes. Aquí las personas pueden ser quienes son. Recomendamos ampliamente nuestras vacantes para personas negras, indígenas, mujeres, LGBTQIA+, personas con discapacidad (PCD) o cualquier otra diversidad.

Descripción de la posición:

Estamos buscando un analista que formará parte del equipo de Customer Success, que atenderá a clientes de las regiones de Norteamérica y Sudamérica y será responsable de garantizar el compromiso en el uso del portal, la retención de los clientes actuales y el aumento de ingresos a través de oportunidades de expansión en la base.

Lo que harás en tu día a día:

  • Ser proactivo con tu cartera de clientes y brindar una atención consultiva, respetando los plazos establecidos;
  • Realizar el onboarding del cliente en la(s) herramienta(s) Atlas;
  • Orientar a los clientes hacia el éxito mediante el intercambio y la asistencia en la aplicación de las mejores prácticas de uso del portal;
  • Realizar capacitaciones de forma dinámica e incluso proponer reciclamientos de entrenamientos a los clientes;
  • Mantener registros precisos de las interacciones con los clientes y actualizar los sistemas de CRM con la información relevante;
  • Analizar datos para proponer mejoras en el proceso;
  • Identificar oportunidades para aumentar el compromiso en el uso por parte de los clientes;
  • Identificar oportunidades para aumentar los ingresos de la base (expansión);
  • Identificar posibles riesgos de churn y tomar medidas preventivas para mitigarlos;
  • Realizar reuniones trimestrales de éxito con los clientes de la cartera;
  • Colaborar con equipos internos, como ventas y desarrollo de productos, para garantizar una experiencia excepcional del cliente.

Lo que buscamos en la persona que formará parte del equipo:

  • Experiencia en Customer Success;
  • Entusiasmo por la IA;
  • Conocimientos básicos de Excel y PowerPoint;
  • Ser comunicativo/a y tener buena redacción;
  • Tener fuertes habilidades de negociación y habilidades analíticas;
  • Conocimiento en productos SaaS;
  • Inglés avanzado/fluido;
  • El portugués es un plus.

Informações adicionais

Nuestro modo de contratación es por contrato de prestación de servicio. Y ofrecemos cómo ayudas:

  • Ayuda a dietas;
  • Ayuda a salud;
  • Home Office Voucher;
  • Clases de Portugués;
  • Birthday Off en tu cumpleaños y de sus hijos.

raw.title: Principal Security Operations Analyst
raw.excerpt: What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations.
raw.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Security Operations Center

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £96,300 to £120,400 base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Principal Security Operations Center Analyst based in EMEA to join our rapidly growing team. In this role, you will triage, investigate, respond to, and remediate intrusions daily. You’ll be surrounded by passionate individuals who are mission-driven to help protect companies worldwide from cyber-attacks. This person will also mentor junior team members, allowing them to grow individually and as a team.

The Huntress Security Operations Center is an elite team that wakes up daily to combat threat actors. You will have daily opportunities to progress your analysis skills while being at the forefront of what’s happening in the wild. With the chance to work on various incidents alongside a skilled team, you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your career and skills, too.

Responsibilities:

  • Function as the lead liaison between the SOC and other Product and Research teams, influencing Product capabilities and ensuring they can be optimally operationalized
  • Advocate for analyst and operational needs to SOC Leadership, ensuring SOC process and technology allow Huntress to deliver exceptional partner outcomes
  • Aid in efforts to build and assure the quality of agentic workflows and investigations
  • Own and complete investigative objectives associated with multi-host intrusions without assistance
  • Triage, investigate, and respond to alerts coming in from the Huntress platform
  • Perform tactical forensic timelining and analysis to determine the root cause of attacks, where possible, and provide remediations needed to remove the threat
  • Investigate suspicious Microsoft M365 and Google Workspace activity
  • Assist in escalations from the product support team for threat-related and SOC-relevant questions
  • Assist our SOC Support team by engaging with customers via video/phone to explain or describe activity observed by the SOC when needed
  • Contribute to detection efforts by helping to create or request net new detections, as well as tuning current detections
  • Provide technical mentorship to more junior team members
  • Contribute regularly to external-facing Huntress content such as blogs, webinars, presentations, and speaking engagements

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 8+ years of experience in a SOC, Incident Response, or Forensics role
  • Ability to explain possible complex alerts/events in a non-complex way, both written and verbal
  • Proven mentoring experience and skills to junior team members, helping them to grow individually and as a team
  • Understanding of Malware Analysis (Configuration of isolated Malware Analysis VM, Identification of File Formats, Basic Static & Dynamic analysis)
  • Demonstrated experience with Windows and/or macOS as an attack surface
  • Strong understanding and experience with Threat Actor Tools and techniques: (MITRE ATT&CK Framework, PowerShell & Command Prompt Terminals, WMIC, Scheduled Tasks, SCM, Windows Domain and host Enumeration Techniques, Basic Lateral Movement Techniques, Basic Persistence Mechanisms, Basic Defense Evasion Techniques, other offensive/Red Team TTPs)
  • Strong experience with Windows Administration or Enterprise Domain Administration and upkeep (Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell, Windows Server Update Service, and Domain Trusts)
  • Strong experience with M365/Cloud attack techniques
  • Demonstrated equivalent of self-guided study experience or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, System Administration, or cybersecurity

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with scripting languages (such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, PHP, JavaScript, or Ruby)
  • Demonstrated experience on platforms like HackTheBox, TryHackMe, Blue Team Labs Online, etc.
  • Participation in cybersecurity competitions such as Capture the Flag, the Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition, etc.
  • Familiarity with MSP tools such as RMMs
  • Previous experience in an MSP/MSSP/MDR role

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement (£398)
  • Generous personal leave entitlements
  • Digital monthly reimbursement (£92)
  • Travel to the US 1-2 times/year for various company events
  • Pension
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

Accommodations:

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to . Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.

Huntress uses artificial intelligence tools to assist in reviewing and evaluating job applications, including resume screening, skills assessment, and candidate matching and comparisons. These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice for more details on our practices and your data privacy rights.

raw.description:
Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.

Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Own

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
  • Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
  • Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs

SQL & Data Management

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
  • Extract and combine data from multiple sources
  • Work with relational databases and structured datasets
  • Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar BI platforms
  • Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
  • Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards

Data Pipelines & Integrations

  • Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
  • Help connect business systems and reporting environments
  • Support reliable movement of data between platforms
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
  • Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows

Reporting Automation

  • Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
  • Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
  • Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Monitor and improve data accuracy
  • Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
  • Validate reporting outputs against source data
  • Improve processes that support reliable reporting
  • Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
  • Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
  • Strong hands-on SQL skills
  • Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar tools
  • Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Professional working English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems
  • Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
  • Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
  • Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
  • Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting

Tools & Technologies

SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
  • Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
  • Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
  • Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
  • Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
  • Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.

Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.

In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and reliability of reporting
  • Quality and usability of dashboards
  • Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
  • SQL query and reporting efficiency
  • Reduction in manual reporting processes
  • Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
  • Improvement in overall data quality
  • Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Data / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.

This is a remote position with up to 50% domestic travel required. Candidates may reside anywhere in the United States.

The National Business Manager - Corporate Accounts will support a high-performing corporate account team by driving strategic planning, operational alignment, and execution excellence across the organization. This role serves as a force multiplier for Account Leaders and Directors, helping translate strategic priorities into coordinated action across Market Access, Payer Strategy, Cross-Portfolio Strategy, APEX, Finance, Medical, and other key stakeholders. The individual will establish processes, tools, and ways of working that improve consistency, visibility, planning discipline, and execution across customer-facing teams. The position will play a critical role in supporting customer planning, Summit follow-through, strategic planning cycles, and cross-functional coordination to ensure account teams can focus on customer engagement and business impact.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Support development and execution of annual account planning and strategic planning processes
  • Establish planning frameworks and tools that enable consistent account planning across Corporate Accounts
  • Coordinate strategic planning milestones, follow-up actions, and deliverables across multiple teams
  • Ensure strategic priorities are translated into actionable plans with clear ownership and accountability

Customer Planning Support

  • Support account teams in preparing for key customer engagements (including conferences) and planning sessions
  • Maintain visibility to customer priorities, action items, and strategic initiatives
  • Develop and manage tools, templates, and best practices that improve planning effectiveness across accounts
  • Identify opportunities to share successful approaches and best practices across teams

Operational Alignment & Coordination

  • Serve as a central point of coordination across Account Teams, Payer Strategy, Cross-Portfolio Strategy, and other Market Access functions
  • Facilitate coordination of customer-specific and cross-customer initiatives requiring multiple stakeholders
  • Support alignment of planning cycles, business reviews, and strategic initiatives across therapeutic areas
  • Help ensure critical initiatives remain on track through effective project management, communication, and issue resolution

Capability Building & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and develop resources and operational alignment to support a high-performing account management model across Corporate Accounts
  • Lead development and implementation of enhanced, consistent, actionable planning processes and tools across teams
  • Support creation and maintenance of effective Ways of Working across account teams and key headquarters partners
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve coordination, and enhance organizational effectiveness
  • Partner with training and learning teams to develop scalable approaches that strengthen account team capabilities, customer planning effectiveness, and deployment of strategic priorities
  • Help define engagement models, expectations, and roles for training resources supporting Corporate Accounts to maximize business impact and field effectiveness

Summit & Strategic Initiative Follow-Through

  • Coordinate follow-up planning and execution after Commercial and Medicare Summits
  • Track actions, decisions, and strategic commitments across therapeutic areas
  • Support consistent implementation of Summit outputs and strategic initiatives across business units
  • Help drive accountability and visibility for key cross-portfolio priorities
  • Partner with training teams to translate Summit outputs, customer insights, and market access priorities into ongoing field education, planning resources, and capability-building activities

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; MBA or Master’s Degree preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Market Access, Account Management, Sales Leadership, Commercial Operations, Strategic Planning, or a related commercial function
  • Previous experience in pharma industry required
  • Track record leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution
  • Experience working effectively across matrixed organizations and influencing without direct authority
  • Demonstrated project management, planning, and organizational effectiveness experience

Essential Skills and Competencies

Critical Success Factors

  • Enable account teams to spend more time with customers and less time navigating internal processes
  • Improve the consistency and quality of account planning across organizations
  • Strengthen coordination between field teams and headquarters functions
  • Drive accountability and follow-through on strategic priorities
  • Build scalable tools, processes, and ways of working that enhance execution across Market Access

Core Competencies

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including interaction with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to simplify complex issues and translate strategy into actionable plans
  • Exceptional planning, organization, and project management skills
  • Proven ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive execution in a dynamic environment
  • Experience navigating matrix organizations and leading initiatives through influence rather than authority
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across functions and organizational levels
  • Sound judgment, business acumen, and ability to connect disparate issues into practical solutions
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and deliver results under tight timelines
  • High degree of professionalism, emotional intelligence, discretion, and organizational savvy
  • Self-starter with intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset
  • Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and other business productivity tools

Customer Care - Fully Remote position in Property & Casualty.

Start Date: January 19, 2027 & January 25, 2027

Schedule: Must be able to work any shift that falls between the hours of 7:00 am - 8:00 pm CST Monday-Friday - some Saturday's required (10 am - 2 pm CST).

In this role, you will primarily support educators by addressing inquiries about their auto and property insurance policies. Through phone calls, emails, and live chats, you will provide exceptional customer service, helping our clients protect their valuable assets.

No license or experience in Insurance? No problem! Horace Mann will provide the necessary training and support to help you obtain your Property & Casualty License if you do not already have one.

If you have a passion for supporting educators and making a meaningful impact, this role could be a great fit for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strong knowledge of Horace Mann Property and Casualty insurance products, services and policies.
  • Handle and problem solve customers' inquiries via phone, email, and chats.
  • Responsible for ensuring a great customer experience in both written and verbal communications.
  • Maintain quality and compliance within every interaction by adhering to all applicable company and state rules and regulations.
  • Responsible for proactive up-sell and cross-sell of insurance solutions to existing customer base.

* Duties, responsibilities, and activities may be assigned or changed *

Requirements

  • Education and Experience:
    • H.S. diploma or GED required (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
    • 2+ years of customer service/business/sales experience preferred.
    • Insurance or Finance industry experience helpful.
  • Licensing and Training:
    • Successfully complete the Service Representative Trainee Program
    • Obtain and maintain Insurance Producers License and Non-Residence License within 12 months of hire and maintain after that
  • Skills and Abilities:
    • Basic math skills and billing interpretation skills.
    • Effective communication, both written and verbally – ability to identify unmet customer needs and provide solutions.
    • Demonstrate active listening, system navigation, research, problem-solving, critical thinking, organization and time management skills.
  • Work Environment and Schedule:
    • Internet speed of at least 10 mb/s download 1mb/s upload – Verification required.
    • Employee must have a private, organized location removed from daily household distractions.

Work location is flexible if approved by the Company except that the position may not be performed remotely in New York, California, Colorado, Washington, New Jersey, Maryland, Alaska, Hawaii, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Mexico, Oregon, or Rhode Island.

Pay Range: $16.20 - $25.43 per hr.

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

#APP

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them. This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

Enterprise Customer Success Manager

Location: Remote | Department: Customer Success | Reports to: Director of Customer Success

More than 2,750 institutions and organizations use Gravyty to power over 25.5 million interactions a year and build lifelong relationships with students, alumni, and donors. We’re looking for a commercially minded Enterprise Customer Success Manager to protect and grow some of our most important partnerships. You’ll be a trusted advisor to your customers and own the results: renewals, expansion, and long-term retention.

Purpose

Retain and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers by preventing churn, driving renewals, and expanding accounts. Build strong relationships and deliver real outcomes along the way.

Mission & Goals

  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to customer leaders and executive stakeholders
  • Maximize customer satisfaction and product adoption
  • Prevent churn and drive renewal and expansion across your enterprise portfolio

Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts and be accountable for churn, retention, and expansion targets
  • Lead renewal and expansion conversations, including cross-selling new solutions, especially our latest product launch
  • Identify risks early and act on them, and spot expansion opportunities and customer champions
  • Deliver QBRs, success plans, and strategic executive check-ins
  • Work with Sales, Product, Support, and Marketing to solve customer issues and grow accounts

Main Tasks

  • Track progress against your churn, retention, and expansion targets, and build action plans to close any gaps
  • Monitor health scores and engagement metrics to catch risk and opportunity early
  • Run renewal, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities from identification through close
  • Guide customers through adoption milestones and business reviews
  • Document success plans and account activity in our CRM and CS platforms
  • Use AI tools to streamline account prep, reporting, and day-to-day workflows

Required Qualifications

  • A proven commercial track record in preventing churn, securing renewals, and growing accounts, with results you can point to
  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS Enterprise Customer Success experience
  • Experience in EdTech, higher education, or nonprofit
  • Experience managing enterprise-level accounts and engaging executive stakeholders
  • Demonstrated success cross-selling or upselling into existing accounts
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Comfort using AI tools, such as Claude Enterprise, to optimize your work and workflows
  • Experience with digital engagement platforms such as CRM, email marketing tools, and CS software like Gainsight
  • Strategic thinking and planning, plus the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing customer focus
  • Experience working with dashboards and reporting

How You Work

You take ownership and follow through. You hold yourself accountable for results, and when things get tough you stay resilient and positive. You’re organized, you take initiative, and you have a bias toward action, efficiency, and continuous improvement. You build relationships easily, with an approachable style that puts customers and teammates at ease. You’re self-aware, you give and receive feedback openly, and you’re a true team player and help make the people around you better.

About Gravyty

At Gravyty, we’re redefining how higher education, K-12, and nonprofits engage students, alumni, and donors. Our AI-powered platform breaks down data and technology silos. It brings student support, enrollment, retention, and lifelong alumni and donor engagement together in one intelligent platform. Trusted by more than 2,750 institutions and organizations, Gravyty drives better outcomes, greater efficiency, and stronger connections.

Our global team of passionate professionals share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and making a real impact. If you want to be part of a dynamic, purpose-driven company, Gravyty is the place for you.

We offer competitive benefits, employer-matched retirement plans, flexible time off, and a supportive environment where your contributions make a difference.

We’re committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need an accommodation at any stage of hiring, please let us know and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.
