raw.excerpt: SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books.
raw.description:
SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books. We’re building the world’s most comprehensive literature platform — combining over 10,000 expert-crafted Study Guides with interactive, innovative tools that make reading more engaging, rewarding, and fun. Beyond summaries, our paid subscription offers chapter-by-chapter analysis, character breakdowns, themes and symbols exploration, thought-provoking discussion questions, and interactive quizzes. Our growing suite of AI-powered features helps readers engage more deeply with texts, whether they’re students tackling assignments, teachers preparing lessons, book clubs seeking richer conversations, or lifelong learners exploring new genres.

Founded over a decade ago, SuperSummary’s website and mobile app has become a trusted, go-to resource for curious readers worldwide. We’re part of the Lift Ventures portfolio of EdTech brands (with over 250 million consumers reached to date) and are a fully remote, global team united by curiosity, creativity, and a shared love of learning.

About the Job

SuperSummary is looking for a Senior Content Designer to join our Design team and shape how readers experience our content. Reporting to the Head of Product, you will find out what readers need, design the content experiences that meet those needs, and use AI to bring them to life across our library.

Our content is our primary value driver, and our biggest opportunities come from rethinking existing formats or inventing new ones. You will run the research that identifies those opportunities, then turn them into concepts that work in both substance and design: what the content says, how it is structured, and how it looks and behaves in the product. You will work closely with our product designers, product managers, and Content team to take concepts from first insight to launch.

The ideal candidate excels at three things: user research, design, and AI-powered content development. You are a designer who thinks in content, with a strong point of view on our content and how we present it. If you have a passion for books, apply today!

This is a part-time contract role.

What You’ll Do

Research and Discover Content Opportunities

  • Talk to readers regularly through interviews, surveys, reviews, and support conversations to find gaps in what our content gives them
  • Partner with CX to turn reader feedback, such as Trustpilot reviews and NPS comments, into design opportunities
  • Validate each opportunity with user research, competitive benchmarking, search demand, and behavioral data before investing in it
  • Challenge long-standing assumptions about our content and bring a clear point of view on which opportunities to pursue first

Design and Prototype Content Experiences

  • Turn research insights into content concepts, defining what each one includes, how it is structured, and how readers move through it
  • Design the information architecture, hierarchy, and layout that make content easy to scan, navigate, and use, especially on mobile
  • Build realistic prototypes with AI and design tools, using real titles and real data, so the team has something concrete to react to
  • Write the copy within your designs, so the words and the interface work as one experience
  • Explore several directions quickly, narrow to the strongest, and present your design decisions with confidence
  • Partner with product designers and product managers to bring concepts into the product

Develop and Scale Content with AI

  • Shape the prompts and content guidelines that generate approved concepts until the output is consistently strong
  • Partner with the Content team on QA across a wide range of titles, holding AI-generated content to the same bar as hand-written work
  • Maintain the content patterns, voice and tone guidance, and AI tools that help the whole team produce stronger work
  • Stay involved through development and testing, and turn launch results into clear next steps

Sample Projects

  • Content Feature Redesign: Use reader feedback to rethink an existing content feature, redesign its structure and presentation, and prototype the new version with real titles
  • New Content Format: Identify a reader need through research, design a new content type, and prototype it until it holds up across the library
  • Study Guide Navigation: Redesign how a Study Guide is organized and navigated to improve findability on mobile and in search
  • Reader Feedback Pipeline: Partner with CX to turn reviews, NPS comments, and support conversations into a prioritized list of design opportunities
  • Content Patterns and Voice: Build the patterns, guidelines, and AI tools that keep content and copy consistent across the product

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in content design, product design, or UX design for a digital product, with a strong focus on content
  • A portfolio showing content experiences you took from user insight to launch, including the research, design decisions, and prototypes behind them
  • Strong UX design skills, including information architecture, layout, hierarchy, and mobile-first design
  • Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools, with the ability to prototype how content will look and work in the product
  • Experience running user research, including interviews and surveys, and turning what you hear into clear design recommendations
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to research, prototype, and generate content, and the ability to iterate on prompts until the output meets a high bar
  • Clear, confident writing, and an understanding of how content structure affects usability and search
  • A genuine passion for books, reading, or book clubs
  • Opinionated and self-directed: you form a point of view quickly, test it, and change course when the evidence says to
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on SEO experience, including keyword research and optimizing content for organic search
  • Experience with Study Guides, test prep, edtech, or other educational content
  • Experience designing AI-generated content experiences or working on prompt quality at scale
  • Familiarity with tools in our stack, including Claude, Figma, Amplitude, Clarity, Sprig, Notion, and Linear
  • Experience on small, high-growth, remote teams across time zones

Benefits

  • Work with a distributed, global team in Latin America, Europe, and the US that has been remote-first since 2018
  • Remote — US-based (location flexible within the United States).

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

We are looking for an experienced Android Software Engineer to join an international engineering project focused on developing and enhancing Android-based payment solutions.

The role involves working with Android system-level components, software architecture, hardware integration, and customer-facing SDKs. You will contribute to the development of reliable, secure, and maintainable software solutions while collaborating closely with firmware engineers, QA specialists, and other technical teams.

The ideal candidate has strong Android development expertise beyond the application layer, excellent analytical skills, and a proactive approach to solving complex technical challenges.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Android software components, system services, and customer-facing APIs.
  • Contribute to software architecture and technical design, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and code quality.
  • Develop and improve communication between Android software and embedded hardware components.
  • Investigate customer-reported issues, analyze system logs, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams on software integration, debugging, and testing.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices and promote the effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong professional experience in Android software development using Java and/or Kotlin.
  • Deep understanding of Android system architecture and platform-level development beyond the application UI.
  • Hands-on experience with Android System Services, Binder IPC, and AIDL.
  • Strong knowledge of Android permissions, privileged applications, and process lifecycle management.
  • Experience with ADB, logcat, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design principles, API design, and clean coding practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to root cause analysis.
  • Experience with code reviews and collaborative software development.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development tools and engineering best practices.
  • Experience with Git and GitLab.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with international engineering teams.
  • Fluent French and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and customers.

raw.description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Sales, Velocity is a key leadership role within the Sales division. You will build, develop and lead a global team of Account Executives who close high volume SMB deals. This is a coaching-first leadership role. Your team will be early in career, and your ability to grow them into confident, consistent performers is what drives results. You will shape the Storyblok Velocity sales motion, scale revenue across regions and own the plans, processes and people strategy behind it. You will also build the talent pipeline from which Storyblok’s next generation of sales leaders will emerge.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Lead, coach and scale a global team of Velocity Account Executives
  • Build and run a structured coaching program covering call reviews, deal inspection, skills development and clear progression paths
  • Design and refine the Velocity sales motion, including playbooks, qualification, pipeline coverage and sales cycle benchmarks for high volume SMB deals as well as graduating self-serve customers to enterprise and running signal based motion
  • Own regional and global revenue targets for the Velocity segment, with accurate forecasting and clear accountability
  • Define and track the activity, conversion and velocity metrics that drive performance, and act on them quickly
  • Partner with Marketing, BDR, PLG, Partners, Sales Operations and Product to optimize lead flow, handoffs and the end-to-end customer journey
  • Lead hiring, onboarding and ramp for new Account Executives so new hires reach productivity fast
  • Build a high-performance, positive and inclusive team culture across time zones
  • Create a clear promotion framework that moves top performers into Mid-Market and Enterprise roles
  • Analyze sales data to spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into action plans
  • Continuously improve sales processes, tooling and automation to increase efficiency at scale
  • Report on Velocity performance and insights to senior leadership on a regular cadence
  • Stay close to market trends, competitor activity and SMB buyer behavior across regions

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of progressive sales experience, with at least 4 years leading sales teams, ideally in a high volume, transactional or SMB environment
  • Proven track record of developing early-career sellers into top performers and building a coaching culture
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding revenue targets with a high velocity sales motion
  • Experience leading distributed or global teams across multiple regions and time zones
  • Experience scaling sales teams and operations in high-growth environments
  • Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting and performance analytics
  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, adapted for short sales cycles
  • Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and hold a junior team to a high standard
  • Proficiency with CRM software and sales analytics tools
  • Experience selling SaaS or similar technology products is highly desirable
  • A positive, can-do attitude and a drive to inspire your team to overcome challenges
  • A proactive approach to identifying and launching initiatives that improve team success and business growth
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to use AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking

U.S. Base Salary Range: $173,800 - $225,000

At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. raw.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

About our Machine Learning Business Banking team

Our mission in Business Banking is to simplify banking for small businesses; making business banking fairer, simpler and more transparent. Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK’s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs.

We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. We’re building intelligent, data-driven and AI/ML-enabled product experiences that help small businesses feel more in control, make better decisions, and get more value from Monzo.

ML is at the core of how we build and scale our products, enabling Monzo to make better decisions, faster, and helping us serve businesses more effectively.

As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist in Business Banking, you’ll help build and ship models that power the next generation of Business Banking experiences. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Analytics Engineering to bring ML-enabled product capability into the heart of how we build for businesses.

Whether it’s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build intelligent product experiences responsibly, our work makes business banking smarter, simpler and more useful for SMEs.

What you'll be working on

As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.

You’ll:

  • Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.
  • Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.
  • Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics.
  • Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs.
  • Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production.
  • Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting).
  • Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor.
  • Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration.

You should apply if

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company.
  • You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact.
  • You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.
  • You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.
  • You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with scikit-learn. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices.
  • You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity.
  • You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day.
  • You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions.
  • You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain.
  • You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas.
  • You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability.
  • You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use.
  • You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.

Nice to haves

  • Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.
  • Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.
  • Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.
  • Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.
  • Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.
  • Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.

The interview process

Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!

30 minute recruiter call

45 minute call with hiring manager

Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on . Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

What’s in it for you

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

raw.description:
Clinical Trial Manager

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.

  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.

  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.

raw.description:
Overview

GCG Connectivity & Power Solutions is expanding our team of technical product specialists and is seeking a Wire Management Product Specialist to help accelerate growth across our wire management, electrical connectivity, and cable accessory product lines.

In this role, you'll combine technical product expertise with a sales-focused mindset to identify new opportunities, expand customer relationships, and help our sales teams deliver the right solutions for industrial and manufacturing applications. You'll work directly with customers, collaborate with territory and inside sales teams, and develop relationships with manufacturers and suppliers to increase awareness, adoption, and sales of our products.

We're looking for someone who understands how wire, cable, and related components work together in real-world, industrial applications and can recognize opportunities that others might overlook. This is an opportunity to become a trusted technical resource while taking an active role in growing a specialized product category.

This is a remote, territory-based position requiring approximately 40–50% travel in states including but not limited to California, Arizona, Nevada, and Colorado, including regular customer visits, joint sales calls, branch visits, and occasional overnight travel.

What You'll Do

  • Drive growth across assigned product categories by identifying new applications, developing sales opportunities, and helping achieve regional revenue and gross margin objectives.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on wire management and cable accessories, including heat shrink tubing, braided sleeving, cable ties, terminals, connectors, wire identification products, and related solutions.

  • Partner with Territory Sales Managers, Inside Sales, and other commercial teams to uncover opportunities, conduct joint customer visits, and provide technical expertise that helps convert opportunities into business.

  • Work directly with customers, including OEMs, contract manufacturers, and panel builders, to understand their applications, identify product requirements, and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Proactively pursue new business opportunities through targeted outreach, customer referrals, existing relationships, and opportunities identified through GCG's sales organization.

  • Provide practical application support, including product selection, competitive cross-referencing, alternative product recommendations, and assistance with technical specifications, samples, and prototypes.

  • Build relationships with key manufacturers and supplier representatives, coordinate joint selling activities, and organize product training sessions to strengthen sales team knowledge and effectiveness.

  • Develop and maintain an active opportunity pipeline, track prospects and design registrations, and provide regular updates on sales activity, opportunity progression, and anticipated revenue.

  • Collaborate with supplier partners and internal teams to address product availability, pricing, technical inquiries, and customer application challenges that may affect sales conversion.

  • Gather customer feedback and competitive intelligence to identify product gaps, emerging applications, and opportunities to expand GCG's product offerings over time.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Associate's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline; 6+ years of applicable industry experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Experience working with wire management, wire and cable, electrical connectivity, cable assemblies, wire harnesses, or related industrial products in a technical, commercial, or application-focused capacity.

  • Strong technical aptitude and practical understanding of how wire, cable, connectors, accessories, and related components are selected and utilized in industrial or manufacturing applications.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify business opportunities, engage customers, influence purchasing decisions, and contribute to revenue growth through technical consultation or sales activities.

  • Ability to interpret customer requirements, product specifications, technical drawings, and datasheets to identify appropriate products and alternative solutions.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to develop relationships across customers, suppliers, and internal sales teams.

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–50% within an assigned region, including occasional overnight travel, and maintain a valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with a manufacturer, distributor, or contract manufacturer specializing in wire management, electrical components, cable assemblies, or wire harness manufacturing.

  • Familiarity with a broad range of wire management products, including heat shrink tubing, sleeving, cable ties, terminals, wire identification systems, and related accessories.

  • Experience in technical sales, applications engineering, product specialization, or business development within industrial or electrical markets.

  • Knowledge of relevant industry standards, certifications, and application requirements, such as UL, CSA, IPC/WHMA-A-620, RoHS, or REACH.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary ranging from $85,000 to $115,000 per year depending on relevant industry and wire / cable product experience; eligibility for performance-based incentive.

  • Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including CDHP and PPO options.

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance.

  • 401(k) with company match and supplemental insurance options.

  • Generous time off, including PTO, paid holidays, parental leave, and compassionate care leave.

  • Wellness and support programs, including EAP resources, wellness incentives, and telehealth.

  • Additional benefits such as dental and vision coverage, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection.

  • A people-first culture that values technical expertise, collaboration, professional development, and long-term career growth.

About GCG Connectivity & Power Solutions

GCG Connectivity & Power Solutions (CPS) delivers a comprehensive range of wire, cable, connectivity, and related products and services to customers across industrial and commercial markets. Bringing together the expertise of established industry brands, including Allied Wire & Cable, Cobra Wire & Cable, ElectroWire, Olympic Wire & Cable, and Seacoast, CPS combines extensive product knowledge, responsive customer service, and value-added solutions to help customers solve complex application and supply chain challenges.

About GCG

At GCG, our mission is to power, connect, and automate our world. With the responsive DNA of a startup and the size of a global leader, we offer top brands and extensive value-added services that make us an invaluable partner to our customers in multiple industry verticals across the globe.

We are committed to meeting the needs of our customers, while focusing attention on our responsibility to the environment, our associates and the communities we serve.

Our Use of AI in Recruiting

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. One-time task. $70 for one approved task, done once. About 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time on Wi-Fi.

Help train AI for smart TVs. You'll film a short video of your face, then a series of short videos in your living room while a set clip plays on your TV. Step-by-step instructions on YouTube show you exactly what to do, and you upload everything through the Mindrift app.

Mindrift connects people with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We're looking for participants based in Mexico to record a short set of videos at home for a smart TV AI project. There is no prior experience required: you follow the video instructions and record with your own iPhone. On this project, participants will:

  • Record a short video of their face;
  • Record a series of short videos in their living room while a set clip plays on the TV, following the step-by-step YouTube instructions (sitting on the couch, moving in front of the TV, using a few everyday items);
  • Set up the phone on a tripod or phone holder and keep the whole setup within about 3 m (10 ft) of the TV;
  • Upload all recordings through the Mindrift app over Wi-Fi.

It's a one-time task: once your recordings are approved, you're done and you get paid.

This opportunity is a good fit for anyone in Mexico with a recent iPhone Pro and a living room with a TV who is looking for a quick, paid, one-time task. You will need:

  • To be 18+, living in Mexico, and speak English or Spanish;
  • An iPhone 15 Pro or newer Pro / Pro Max model with 256 GB or more and at least 70 GB free. iPhone 14 Pro / Pro Max and other phones can't record this task;

  • Wi-Fi connection for uploading large video files

Additional requirements

  • About 3 m (10 ft) of open space in front of the TV
  • Alone in the room while recording
  • A tripod or phone holder, a chair, glasses with clear lenses, a baseball cap and a blanket

Language and Availability

  • Location: Mexico
  • Availability: a one-time task of about 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time; you choose when to record

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Record and upload the videos → Get paid

How to apply

Please confirm in your application which iPhone model you have (Pro / Pro Max, 15 or newer), its storage size, and the country you live in.

Earnings

$70 (USD) for one approved task, paid once. The task is done once; repeat participation is only possible if approved by the project coordinator.

Project time expectations

This is a one-time task. Recording takes about 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time on Wi-Fi. You choose when to record. Recordings need to follow the instructions and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Programs Manager to our Revenue team in Brazil!

This role is to join our global Revenue Growth function, responsible for owning and scaling Wellhub’s expansion agenda across our SMB client base and extending it up-market to larger accounts. As a senior individual contributor, you will run the program end-to-end—using data analysis, A/B experimentation, and monthly waves to drive incremental revenue while building agentic and automated workflows to eliminate manual execution. The position will work closely with SMB Commercial Leadership, Value Management, Sales Operations, and Commercial Finance to design next-generation growth levers and forecast financial impact. This is a great opportunity to own a high-impact global growth engine and take cutting-edge AI automation into production to bring our existing-client revenue to the next level.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Owns the scaled Revenue Growth strategy globally, in partnership with SMB Commercial Leadership, Value Management and Sales Operations, including end-to-end monthly execution: leverage SQL for cohort identification, price-increase, off-waiver and step-up-waiver waves, and tracking against budget and attainment.
  • Defines where and how to expand the Programmatic Agenda up-market to larger clients, including which cohorts, levers and pricing guardrails fit those segments, in partnership with Value Management and Commercial Leadership.
  • Designs and runs A/B experiments, with clear hypotheses and success metrics, to drive incremental growth or improve the operational efficiency of the Revenue Growth strategy.
  • Leads the monthly and quarterly cross-functional Revenue Growth forums with commercial, operations and finance leadership, and independently delivers executive summaries of performance and program health to senior leadership.
  • Drives financial impact analysis with Commercial Finance and Sales Operations so teams understand expected versus actual impact, and forecasts revenue growth from the existing client base.
  • Drives and influences the development and prioritization of new programs with Product, Product Marketing, Client Marketing, CX/CRG, Value Management and Commercial teams, to grow incremental client revenue, improve net revenue margins, and improve client communication and operational efficiency.
  • Builds agentic and automated workflows that automate meaningful parts of the program, evaluating where an agent should replace a manual process and where it should not; provides continuity on in-flight automation and takes it from prototype to production.
  • Analyzes net margins across the SMB base.
  • Owns results dashboards and the retention-guidelines discount calculator used by CS/CRG agents, keeping both aligned to Value Management's current guidance.
  • Scales proven GTM motions globally, supporting Global Programs and the Commercial and Channel Partner teams by sharing learnings and providing operational guidance.
  • Determines the incremental and future development of the Client Console, partnering with Product Development and Analytics to prioritize the features needed to manage Wellhub clients at scale.
  • Analyzes large datasets (SQL) to track program performance (NRR, renewal rate, MRR churn at renewal), and communicates findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A strategic, data-driven professional with proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, growth strategy, or program management, with a proven track record of scaling commercial initiatives.

  • You have extensive experience in SQL and large-dataset analysis, paired with solid in-depth knowledge of Salesforce and BI tools (such as Looker Studio) to build dashboards and track core metrics like NRR, renewal rates, MRR churn, and net margins.

  • An analytical problem-solver with a deep understanding of pricing and renewal mechanics, capable of designing rigorous A/B experiments and partnering with Finance to forecast revenue impact against actuals.

  • You are curious about and hands-on with AI and workflow automation, bringing the ability to take agentic workflows from prototype to production—while exercising sharp judgment on where automation should replace manual work and where human nuance is essential.

  • A true self-starter who thrives on end-to-end ownership, seamlessly collaborating with and influencing cross-functional stakeholders across Commercial Leadership, Product, Marketing, Finance, and CX to turn complex ideas into global motions.

  • A strong communicator, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead monthly and quarterly business forums, deliver clear executive summaries to senior leadership, and translate technical insights for non-technical audiences.

  • You bring fluency in both English and Portuguese, allowing you to navigate global programs and local operations effortlessly.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, or analytical program management, hands-on proficiency in SQL, and fluency in English and Portuguese are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

raw.description:
Job Description: Spanish Language Expert (LATAM)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Argentina or Colombia, Remote

About the Role

We are seeking Spanish Language Experts based in Argentina or Colombia to support a specialized AI training project. You will use your knowledge of Latin American Spanish dialects, accents, and regional language variations to improve the accuracy and quality of AI systems through audio annotation and transcription.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio recordings featuring diverse Latin American Spanish dialects and accents.
  2. Annotate audio and speaker metadata, including audio quality, background noise, dialect, accent, age, and speaking style.
  3. Review and correct Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) transcripts using accurate Latin American Spanish spelling, vocabulary, and conventions.
  4. Identify and annotate regional linguistic features, idioms, slang, and pronunciation patterns, including seseo, Rioplatense rehilamiento of /ʝ/, aspiration or deletion of syllable-final /s/, and voseo.
  5. Recognize distinctions across regional varieties, including Mexican, Caribbean, Andean, Rioplatense, Central American, and Chilean Spanish.
  6. Ensure annotations are accurate, consistent, and aligned with project guidelines, maintaining clear distinctions between Latin American Spanish varieties.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in Latin American Spanish, with a strong understanding of its regional varieties.
  2. Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related field.
  3. Ability to distinguish between different Latin American Spanish dialects and accents.
  4. Familiarity with regional vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions, including indigenous-language and English influences.
  5. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to recognize subtle linguistic differences.
  6. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity and accuracy.
  7. Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an advantage but not required.

raw.description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales team. In this remote-first role, you will proactively hunt new business while working from a populated funnel of qualified demos and named accounts. Through a consultative, value-driven approach, you will uncover customer challenges across workplace investigations, compliance, employee relations, risk management, incident management, and case management programs. You will position the full Case IQ platform and portfolio of solutions, helping customers understand how our technology can support a wide range of organizational risk, reporting, investigation, and case management needs. You will partner closely with Solutions Engineers to deliver compelling product demonstrations and technical validation while leading the overall sales process from discovery through close.

This role may require occasional travel for client visits, industry events, and tradeshows.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting to identify, engage, and qualify potential customers while expanding pipeline and generating new business opportunities.
  • Lead consultative discovery conversations to understand customer challenges, business objectives, current processes, and success criteria.
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineers to deliver tailored product demonstrations, technical deep dives, proof-of-concepts, and solution presentations that align with customer needs.
  • Position and sell the full Case IQ portfolio of solutions, identifying opportunities to address multiple customer use cases and business challenges through a unified platform approach.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Case IQ's platform, portfolio of solutions, use cases, buyer personas, and competitive landscape.
  • Achieve and exceed sales quotas by translating complex customer requirements into business value and measurable outcomes.
  • Build relationships with multiple stakeholders, including HR, Compliance, Legal, Employee Relations, Investigations, Risk, Audit, and Security teams.
  • Manage opportunities with strong follow-up, accurate Salesforce hygiene, stakeholder mapping, and clear next steps throughout the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Sales Operations, Implementation, Customer Success, and leadership to drive successful customer outcomes.
  • Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and professionalism while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

What Success Looks Like

30 Days

  • Learn Case IQ's platform, portfolio of solutions, core use cases, buyer personas, sales process, territory priorities, competitive positioning, and key market terminology.
  • Begin participating in discovery calls, demonstrations, and customer meetings alongside Sales and Solutions Engineering teammates.

60 Days

  • Conduct discovery conversations independently and collaborate effectively with Solutions Engineers to advance opportunities.
  • Build qualified pipeline through outbound activity and demonstrate growing market and product fluency.

90 Days

  • Independently manage opportunities through the sales cycle, effectively position Case IQ solutions against customer pain points, and maintain strong opportunity progression and forecast hygiene.
  • Demonstrate the ability to deliver compelling product overviews and partner seamlessly with Solutions Engineers during technical evaluations.

6Months

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, demonstrate strong product and market knowledge, and show consistent progress toward quota attainment and territory goals.

1 Year

  • Be fully ramped as a trusted Account Executive who consistently delivers new business growth, accurately forecasts results, and contributes to the ongoing success of Case IQ's sales organization.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with B2B software sales experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Experience selling into HR, compliance, legal, employee relations, investigations, risk, audit, security, or related functions is an asset.
  • Strong discovery, consultative selling, and business-value communication skills.
  • Ability to present complex software solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives and operational leaders.
  • Comfortable partnering with Solutions Engineers and cross-functional teams to develop winning strategies and drive customer success throughout the buying journey.
  • Experience selling enterprise software platforms that solve multiple business problems across departments and stakeholder groups is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Experience with Salesforce and modern sales methodologies is an asset.

Perks and Benefits

  • Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)
  • Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
  • Generous professional development budget
  • RRSP/ 401k matching program
  • Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at .

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Nous recherchons un Analyste, conformité TI pour rejoindre IQVIA Laboratories en télétravail au Canada.


Remarque importante : Ce poste est offert en télétravail partout au Canada. Les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada et doivent résider au Canada pendant toute la durée de leur emploi.


Nous recrutons des innovateurs passionnés qui font progresser les soins de santé grâce à une collaboration réfléchie et inclusive. Si vous souhaitez donner davantage de sens à votre carrière, joignez-vous à nous alors que nous transformons et accélérons la recherche et le développement.


À titre d’analyste en conformité TI, vous serez responsable de superviser les activités de conformité liées aux systèmes validés et de soutenir la préparation aux audits au sein d’IQVIA Laboratories. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes des technologies de l’information, de l’assurance qualité et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise afin d’assurer la conformité réglementaire, le maintien de l’état validé des systèmes et le succès des audits internes, des audits clients et des inspections réglementaires.


Ce que vous ferez :

  • Planifier, coordonner, exécuter, documenter et clôturer les revues périodiques des applications validées conformément aux procédures de qualité et de conformité.
  • Agir à titre de principal point de contact TI pour les audits internes, les audits clients, les inspections réglementaires et les évaluations de conformité.
  • Coordonner les activités d’audit et veiller à ce que les livrables, les réponses et la documentation justificative soient fournies avec exactitude et dans les délais requis.
  • Gérer et maintenir le calendrier des audits TI afin d’assurer une préparation et un soutien adéquats aux audits.
  • Analyser les résultats des audits, suivre les indicateurs de conformité, identifier les tendances et formuler des recommandations d’amélioration continue.
  • Offrir de la formation en matière de conformité et de qualité aux équipes TI et aux parties prenantes en fonction des résultats d’audit, des écarts de processus et des exigences réglementaires.
  • Réviser la documentation de validation et maintenir des dossiers prêts pour les audits afin de soutenir les systèmes validés et la conformité des systèmes informatisés.
  • Soutenir les activités de CAPA (actions correctives et préventives), les révisions de procédures opératoires normalisées (PON), les revues d’accès utilisateurs, les essais de reprise après sinistre et les autres initiatives liées à la conformité afin de maintenir l’état validé.

Ce que nous recherchons :

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en systèmes d’information, en assurance qualité ou dans un domaine connexe, ainsi qu’un minimum de trois (3) années d’expérience en technologies de l’information, conformité, soutien aux audits, assurance qualité ou validation des systèmes informatisés.
  • Expérience dans le soutien d’audits internes, d’audits clients, d’inspections réglementaires ou de programmes de conformité dans un environnement réglementé.
  • Expérience liée au cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC), au cycle de vie de validation des logiciels (SVLC), à la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV) ou à des processus qualité similaires.
  • La certification CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) et/ou la certification ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) constituent un atout.
  • Une combinaison équivalente de formation, d’études et d’expérience pourra être considérée en remplacement du diplôme.

Les connaissances, compétences et aptitudes requises pour ce poste :

  • Excellente connaissance des exigences réglementaires et des bonnes pratiques de l’industrie, notamment FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, Annexe 11, ICH E6, ISO 15189 et des principes GxP appliqués aux systèmes informatisés réglementés.
  • Expérience dans l’interprétation et l’application des exigences réglementaires, la gestion de programmes de conformité, l’évaluation des risques et le soutien aux audits internes, aux audits clients et aux inspections réglementaires.
  • Connaissance de la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV), de la documentation de validation, de la gestion des changements, des CAPA, des systèmes de gestion de la qualité (QMS), du contrôle documentaire, de la gouvernance TI et des méthodologies d’essais logiciels.
  • Connaissance des principes et pratiques d’audit; la certification CISA et/ou ISTQB constitue un atout.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes, en analyse, en communication, en gestion des parties prenantes et en coordination de projets, combinées à une grande rigueur et à un souci exceptionnel du détail.
  • Vous devrez travailler directement avec des départements, des équipes, des fonctions de soutien et des parties prenantes d’IQVIA situés partout au Canada et à travers le monde. Par conséquent, une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, est nécessaire à l’exercice des fonctions de ce poste.

Ce que nous vous offrons :


Nous plaçons nos employés au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons et nous nous engageons à leur offrir, ainsi qu’à leur famille, des avantages sociaux qui répondent à leurs besoins diversifiés et évolutifs. Nous investissons dans des programmes intégrés d’avantages sociaux et dans des ressources favorisant le bien-être physique, mental, émotionnel, financier et social de nos employés afin qu’ils puissent s’épanouir à la maison comme au travail, à chaque étape de leur parcours de bien-être.


Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages sociaux, visitez

We are seeking an IT Compliance Analyst to join IQVIA Laboratories in a remote position based in Canada.


Important Note: This is a remote position open to candidates residing anywhere in Canada. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must reside in Canada throughout their employment.


We hire passionate innovators who drive healthcare forward through thoughtful and inclusive collaboration. If you want to discover a career with greater purpose, join us as we transform and accelerate research and development.


As an IT Compliance Analyst, you will oversee compliance activities related to validated systems and support audit readiness across IQVIA Laboratories. You will partner with IT, Quality Assurance, and business stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance, maintain validated system status, and successfully support client, internal, and regulatory audits.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Plan, schedule, conduct, document and close periodic reviews for validated applications in accordance with quality and compliance procedures.
  • Serve as the primary IT point of contact for internal audits, client audits, regulatory inspections and compliance assessments.
  • Coordinate audit activities and ensure audit deliverables, responses and supporting documentation are provided accurately and on time.
  • Manage and maintain the IT audit calendar and ensure appropriate audit support and resource planning.
  • Analyze audit findings, track compliance metrics, identify trends and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Deliver compliance and quality training to IT teams and stakeholders based on audit outcomes, process gaps and regulatory requirements.
  • Review validation documentation and maintain audit-ready records supporting validated systems and computerized system compliance.
  • Support CAPA activities, SOP reviews, user access reviews, disaster recovery testing and other compliance-related initiatives to maintain the validated state.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Quality Assurance or a related field with a minimum of three (3) years of experience in IT, compliance, audit support, quality assurance or computer systems validation.
  • Experience supporting internal audits, client audits, regulatory inspections or compliance programs within a regulated environment.
  • Experience working with Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Software Validation Lifecycle (SVLC), Computerized Systems Validation (CSV) or similar quality processes.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and/or ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) certificationpreferred.
  • Other Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.

The Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Needed for This Role:

  • Strong knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, Annex 11, ICH E6, ISO 15189, GxP principles and industry best practices for regulated computerized systems.
  • Experience interpreting and applying regulatory requirements, managing compliance programs, conducting risk assessments and supporting internal, client and regulatory audits.
  • Knowledge of Computerized Systems Validation (CSV), validation documentation, change control, CAPA management, Quality Management Systems (QMS), document control, IT governance and software testing methodologies.
  • Knowledge of audit principles and practices; CISA and/or ISTQB certification is considered an asset.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, stakeholder management, organizational and project coordination skills with strong attention to detail.
  • You will be required to work directly with IQVIA departments, teams, support functions and stakeholders located across Canada and around the world therefore, a functional knowledge of English, both written and spoken, is necessary to perform the duties of this position.

We invest in integrated benefits programs and resources to take care of our employees’ physical, mental and emotional, financial and social well-being so they can thrive at home and at work, at any stage of their well-being journey.

Creative Quality Assurance Specialist - DotYeti

Important Note: ﻿This position operates within the Manila, Philippines time zone (4 PM - 12 MN PHT). Flexibility with working hours is essential.

At DotYeti, we believe great design should feel as good to make as it does to look at. We're a fully remote creative team helping businesses bring their ideas to life. Everything we make starts with two things: artistry in every detail and excellence in every delivery. The rest comes naturally: joy in the work, growth for everyone, and a team that has each other's backs.

﻿

﻿What you'll do:

  • Creative Craft: ﻿Thorough validations, clear actionable design feedback, and error-free QA reports, delivered with real precision and the kind of detail people notice.
  • Quality & Delivery: Review and check design outputs to ensure flawless functionality, accuracy, and brand alignment. Deliver verified creative assets and request updates that are polished, on-brand, and on time. You hold all work to a high bar before anyone else has to.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with design and accounts team to turn briefs into seamless creative deliverables, share feedback openly, and keep projects moving (and fun).
  • Problem Solving: Identify process gaps, validate output readiness, and resolve creative execution errors before production, finding fixes that last, not just quick patches.
  • Learning & Tools: Explore new tools, AI workflows, and techniques that help the team create better work.﻿

Our ideal candidate:﻿

  • Has 3+ years of experience in the creative industry, ideally in a design or QA role.
  • A graduate of Multimedia Arts, Mass Communication, Advertising, or a related field.
  • Comfortable with the Adobe Creative Suite and familiar with QA or project management tools.
  • Has a great eye and cares how things look, feel, and work, not just whether they're finished.
  • Takes pride in the details and doesn't call it done until it's right.
  • Is naturally curious, always tinkering with a new tool, trick, or technique.
  • Communicates clearly, offers help, asks for it, and celebrates wins with the team.﻿

Bonus Points for:

  • Previous startup and/or design agency experience.
  • Experience handling design requests for MSMEs, large corporations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.

What We Offer:﻿

  • Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment in an independent contractor setup.
  • Paid Time Off & Benefits: Generous paid time off, mental health leave, and comprehensive health coverage.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary with yearly performance-based raises.
  • Equipment Allowance: Allowance provided to equip your home office.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunity to grow with a talented and collaborative team.

How we hire:

  1. Let's get to know each other. A relaxed first chat about how you work, how you communicate, and what makes work fun for you.
  2. Show us your craft. This is the big one. A practical assessment where we look at your creativity, your attention to detail, and the polish of the final result.
  3. Final interview. We'll talk through your work, how you tackle problems, and where you want to grow next.
  4. Job offer!﻿

Note: We are currently not accepting meeting requests for this position through our website. Submit your application via this job ad.

Customer Success Manager / Account Manager – Client Retention & Growth

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager / Account Manager to manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers, support onboarding, maintain customer satisfaction, and improve retention.

This is a client-facing role focused on relationship management, customer onboarding, account health, retention, and long-term customer value.

You’ll serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, understand their goals, ensure they receive value from the company’s services, and proactively address concerns before they become retention risks.

If you’re a strong communicator who enjoys building lasting client relationships and taking ownership of the customer experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Relationship Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with clients
  • Conduct regular customer check-ins and account conversations
  • Understand each customer’s goals, priorities, and expectations
  • Maintain professional, responsive communication throughout the customer lifecycle

Customer Onboarding & Implementation

  • Support new customers through onboarding and implementation
  • Help customers understand processes, services, and next steps
  • Coordinate internally to ensure a smooth transition after the sale
  • Track onboarding progress and follow up on outstanding actions
  • Ensure customers have a strong experience from the beginning of the relationship

Customer Success & Value

  • Understand what success looks like for each customer
  • Ensure customers receive ongoing value from the company’s services
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve the customer experience
  • Conduct regular check-ins to understand satisfaction and changing needs
  • Maintain consistent engagement across assigned accounts

Retention & Risk Management

  • Identify customer concerns and potential retention risks early
  • Address issues proactively before they escalate
  • Handle difficult customer conversations professionally
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues
  • Follow through until concerns are fully addressed
  • Help maintain strong customer satisfaction and retention

Account Growth

  • Identify potential upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Recognize additional customer needs during account conversations
  • Coordinate appropriate opportunities with internal teams
  • Support long-term account growth through strong customer relationships

CRM & Account Management

  • Maintain accurate customer and account records in the CRM
  • Document conversations, concerns, follow-ups, and next steps
  • Keep account information organized and current
  • Track outstanding customer requests and commitments
  • Ensure important follow-ups are completed on time

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, client services, or a related client-facing role
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Ability to handle difficult customer conversations professionally
  • Strong organization and follow-through
  • Ability to manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously
  • Comfortable taking ownership of customer concerns through resolution
  • CRM experience preferred
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to overlap with U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts
  • Experience supporting customer onboarding or implementation
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Experience identifying upsell or cross-sell opportunities
  • Experience working with U.S.-based customers
  • Background in B2B services, SaaS, agencies, or other client-focused businesses

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Naturally build strong relationships with customers
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently
  • Proactively identify problems instead of waiting for complaints
  • Stay calm during challenging customer conversations
  • Follow through consistently on commitments
  • Care about customer satisfaction and long-term retention
  • Can balance customer needs with business priorities
  • Take ownership without requiring constant supervision

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong customer satisfaction and account relationships
  • Smooth and organized customer onboarding
  • Consistent customer communication and check-ins
  • Early identification and resolution of retention risks
  • Strong customer retention
  • Timely resolution of customer concerns
  • Accurate and organized CRM records
  • Identification of appropriate upsell and cross-sell opportunities

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in customer success, account management, client services, onboarding, or customer relationship management and enjoy building strong, long-term client relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help deliver an exceptional customer experience while supporting retention and account growth.
