Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - Oncology (Northeast)

Job Location: Virtual United States New York

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior CRA at Worldwide

As a Senior CRA, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted with the highest standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will help drive the successful execution of studies from site qualification through closeout, supporting the delivery of reliable data that advances clinical research.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, study teams, and sponsors, building strong relationships while providing leadership, guidance, and oversight across clinical trial activities. You’ll have the opportunity to influence study success through proactive monitoring, site management, and collaboration with global teams.

Your contributions will directly support high-quality study delivery by ensuring protocol adherence, regulatory compliance, timely data collection, and effective site performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.

Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across the Northeastern United States. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in the Northeastern United States Travel will primarily be regional, with occasional travel to support sites in other locations as needed.

What You'll Do

  • Manage clinical research activities at investigative sites participating in Worldwide clinical studies.
  • Identify and assess potential research sites to support successful study execution.
  • Coordinate study start-up activities, including collection of regulatory documentation and support of contract and budget processes.
  • Conduct all types of monitoring visits: Pre-Site Selection Visits (PSSVs), Study Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs) and Closeout Visits (COVs).
  • Train site personnel on protocol requirements, data collection processes, and safety reporting expectations.
  • Monitor site performance and provide ongoing support throughout study maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with informed consent requirements, safety reporting obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with sites and study teams to drive data quality, participant safety, and overall study success.
  • Support site closeout activities and ensure study requirements are completed at the conclusion of the trial.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree or a Nursing Degree, along with 5+ years as a regional, traveling Clinical Research Associate.
  • Required experience monitoring Oncology clinical trials.
  • Requires travel within the specified region; 8 – 10 DOS monthly, some visits will be remote
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, site management, and regulatory requirements.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us on LinkedIn.

raw.description:
About Tereina

Tereina is on a mission to revolutionize B2B payments. We are a well-funded, early-stage startup building cutting-edge solutions that transform how businesses move money. Our platform handles cross-border payment processing, counterparty management, bank account administration, and compliance workflows for eterprise customers worldwide.

We are building a modern portal application using a service-oriented architecture with Spring Boot microservices, a Spring Boot BFF (Backend for Frontend), and a custom frontend built with SAP UI5 Web Components, React and TypeScript. We are currently evolving our UX with a clean, data-rich design language focused on advanced search, tabular data views, and dashboard analytics.

About the Role

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will be a key technical leader responsible for shaping the user experience of the Tereina Portal. You will own the frontend architecture, drive the implementation of our new design system, and work across the full stack to ensure our UX vision is realized with production-quality code. You will partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to deliver enterprise-grade interfaces for payment operations, counterparty management, and compliance with workflows.

This role demands deep expertise in modern frontend technologies, a strong eye for design quality, and the ability to influence architecture decisions across the portal and its supporting BFF layer. You will mentor other engineers on UX best practices and help define our standards for accessibility, performance, and component reusability.

Key Responsibilities

Framework Development

These are the responsibilities focused on building the underlying systems, architecture, and shared infrastructure:

  • Frontend Architecture: Own and evolve the frontend architecture of the Tereina Portal, including the component library, state management patterns, and data-fetching layer built on our existing frontend infrastructure.
  • Design System Implementation: Lead the implementation of our evolving design system, translating UX designs into reusable, accessible components using SAP UI5 Web Components and TypeScript. Establish patterns for dashboards, data tables, search interfaces, and detail views.
  • BFF Collaboration: Work closely with the BFF layer (Spring Boot) to shape API contracts, optimize data-fetching patterns, and ensure the portal proxy controllers deliver exactly what the frontend needs. Influence the design of search proxy endpoints and OpenAPI specifications.
  • Performance & Accessibility: Champion frontend performance optimization (lazy loading, caching strategies, efficient re-renders) and WCAG accessibility standards across all portal views.

Rollout & Adoption

These are the responsibilities focused on shipping features, driving usage, and working across teams:

  • Search & Data Views: Architect the frontend implementation of our new standardized search framework, integrating table-based server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering via our REST filter contracts. Implement column configuration, saved searches, and spreadsheet exports.
  • Dashboard & Analytics UX: Build rich, interactive dashboard experiences including payment summaries, held-payment alerts, trend charts, and failure-analysis views.
  • Implement data visualizations that surface actionable insights for enterprise payment operations.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product, Design, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into UX solutions. Drive UX technical decisions and advocate for user experience quality in architectural discussions.
  • Mentorship: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on frontend best practices, code quality, component design, and UX engineering principles. Lead code reviews, establish coding standards, and help shape the engineering culture as the team grows.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on frontend development and UX engineering
  • Expert proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.
  • Expert-level React experience, including deep knowledge of hooks, state management patterns, and component architecture, with a track record of building complex, data-rich web applications
  • Hands-on experience with headless table libraries (TanStack Table preferred) including server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering
  • Proven ability to build responsive, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) interfaces for enterprise applications
  • Experience with BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns and REST API integration, including OpenAPI-generated clients
  • Solid understanding of authentication flows (OAuth2/OIDC, session-based auth) and security best practices (CSRF, CSP)
  • Experience with AI agent frontends — streaming UI, conversation management, and integration with Spring AI, LangChain, or MCP backends
  • Experience with data visualization libraries and building dashboard interfaces with charts and analytics components
  • Strong system design skills with the ability to influence architecture decisions across frontend and API layers
  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating in cross-functional agile teams
  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is required; all engineering collaboration, documentation, code reviews, and stakeholder communication are conducted in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP UI5, SAP UI5 Web Components, or enterprise UI frameworks in regulated industries
  • Familiarity with Spring Boot BFF architectures and Java/Kotlin backend services
  • Background in fintech, payment processing, or B2B financial platforms
  • Experience with SheetJS or similar client-side data export libraries
  • Knowledge of JPA Specifications or similar backend query patterns and how they map to frontend filter UIs
  • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications with organization-scoped data access
  • Track record of leading frontend architecture decisions and establishing engineering standards

Why Join Tereina?

  • Shape the Product: Own the UX of a platform that processes millions in B2B payments.
  • Your work directly impacts how enterprise customers manage counterparties, execute payments, and maintain compliance.
  • Technical Voice: Your opinions on API design, BFF contracts, and component architecture will directly influence how our stack is built. You won't just consume APIs – you'll help shape them.
  • Modern Stack: Work with a thoughtfully chosen technology stack that values simplicity and pragmatism over hype. We adopt new tools where they add real value.
  • Early-Stage Impact: Join a well-funded startup where your contributions shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.
  • Full-Stack Exposure: Collaborate across the entire stack, from frontend components to BFF orchestration to backend service APIs.
  • AI-Forward Culture: We embrace AI as a tool for innovation and efficiency. We are looking for team members who are curious, adaptable, and excited to leverage AI in their work.
  • Team & Growth: Work with a collaborative, diverse team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and work-life balance.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about building performant, secure, and user-friendly web applications and want to shape the future of payments technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Tereina embraces AI as a tool for innovation, efficiency, and growth. We're looking for team members who are curious, adaptable, and excited to leverage AI in their work—no matter the role. Tereina is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an AI Engineer / AI Automation Specialist to build AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, integrations, and business automations.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can take an AI or automation use case from idea to working implementation. You’ll combine software development, LLMs, APIs, automation platforms, and agentic workflows to build systems that reduce manual work and improve business efficiency.

You’ll work across generative AI, AI agents, API integrations, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and internal tooling, while continuously evaluating emerging AI technologies.

What You’ll Own

AI Applications & Agent Development

  • Design and build AI-powered applications and workflows
  • Develop AI agents that can execute structured tasks and business processes
  • Build agentic workflows using LLMs, tools, APIs, and business logic
  • Turn manual processes into scalable AI-assisted systems
  • Improve existing AI applications as business requirements evolve

LLM & Generative AI Integration

  • Integrate LLMs with internal systems and third-party platforms
  • Build structured workflows around generative AI models
  • Develop and refine prompts, tools, and reusable AI components
  • Implement reliable structured outputs and workflow logic
  • Evaluate AI responses for quality, consistency, and reliability

Automation & Business Workflows

  • Build automated workflows that reduce repetitive manual work
  • Connect applications and business systems using APIs and automation platforms
  • Develop workflows using tools such as Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar platforms
  • Troubleshoot failed or unreliable automations
  • Continuously improve workflow efficiency and scalability

APIs & Integrations

  • Build and maintain API integrations between AI systems and external platforms
  • Work with webhooks and third-party services
  • Manage data flows between applications and automation workflows
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and improve system reliability

Development & Internal Tools

  • Build internal tools that improve team productivity and operational efficiency
  • Develop technical solutions using Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Write clean, maintainable code for AI and automation systems
  • Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and debugging
  • Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of AI-powered solutions

AI Quality, Testing & Reliability

  • Evaluate AI output quality and reliability
  • Test prompts, workflows, agents, and integrations
  • Identify edge cases and failure points
  • Improve AI systems based on real-world performance
  • Build appropriate safeguards and validation into automated workflows

Research & Experimentation

  • Research and test emerging AI technologies
  • Evaluate new LLMs, agent frameworks, AI coding tools, and automation platforms
  • Identify practical opportunities to apply new technologies
  • Recommend improvements based on testing and business impact

Documentation & Process Development

  • Document AI systems, workflows, integrations, and processes
  • Create clear technical documentation for ongoing maintenance
  • Maintain organized records of automation logic and system dependencies
  • Build repeatable processes that allow successful solutions to scale

Requirements

  • Professional experience in software development, automation, AI, or a related technical role
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs and generative AI
  • Experience building AI-powered applications, workflows, or automations
  • Experience integrating APIs and third-party platforms
  • Programming experience, preferably with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Familiarity with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows
  • Understanding of prompt development and structured AI workflows
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to independently take projects from concept through implementation
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar automation platforms
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step agentic workflows
  • Familiarity with webhooks and event-driven integrations
  • Experience developing internal business tools
  • Experience working with structured LLM outputs and tool/function calling
  • Familiarity with cloud deployment and modern development workflows
  • Experience evaluating and monitoring AI system performance

Tools & Technologies

LLMs & Generative AI | Python | JavaScript/TypeScript | APIs | Webhooks | Make | Zapier | n8n | AI Coding Tools | Agentic Workflows | Automation Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Build with AI rather than simply use AI for basic productivity
  • Enjoy turning manual workflows into automated systems
  • Can move from an idea to a functional technical solution independently
  • Understand both software development and business automation
  • Experiment with new AI tools and technologies regularly
  • Think critically about AI reliability rather than assuming outputs are correct
  • Are comfortable troubleshooting across APIs, code, and automation platforms
  • Prioritize practical business impact over experimentation for its own sake

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include building an AI agent, connecting an LLM to a business platform through an API, developing an automation in n8n or Make, troubleshooting an existing workflow, or creating an internal tool that eliminates repetitive work.

You may also test prompts and agent behavior, evaluate AI output quality, document systems, and research emerging AI technologies that could improve existing workflows.

In short: you turn AI capabilities into practical, reliable systems that automate work and improve business operations.

Key Metrics for Success

  • AI workflows successfully deployed into real business processes
  • Reduction in repetitive manual work
  • Reliability and accuracy of AI-powered systems
  • Successful API and third-party integrations
  • Speed from idea to working implementation
  • Automation uptime and workflow reliability
  • Quality and maintainability of technical documentation
  • Measurable operational efficiency created through AI

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Technical / AI Automation Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation, APIs, and software development and enjoy turning business problems into working AI-powered systems, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build practical AI systems that automate work and improve how businesses operate.

raw.description:
The Senior Contract Configuration Specialist serves as a senior technical resource responsible for interpreting complex provider contracts, configuring reimbursement methodologies, and ensuring accurate claims adjudication across multiple systems. This role partners closely with Contracting, Claims, and technology stakeholders to support payment integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. The Senior Contract Configuration Specialist leverages advanced knowledge of reimbursement methodologies, contract interpretation, testing, and data analysis to support business initiatives, improve configuration accuracy, and drive consistent outcomes across the organization.

What You'll Do

Contract Configuration & Reimbursement
  • Interpret complex, ambiguous, and non-standard provider contracts and agreements to ensure accurate system configuration.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of complex fee schedules, vendor contracts, and capitation arrangements.
  • Configure complex reimbursement methodologies for provider, facility, ancillary, and tertiary contracts across multiple systems.
  • Define and execute testing strategies to validate contract configurations and ensure alignment between contract language and claims adjudication outcomes.
  • Maintain high standards of data accuracy and configuration quality that comply with SOX controls and Operational oversight.
Problem Resolution & Operational Support
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for internal stakeholders regarding provider configuration and reimbursement issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex claims payment and configuration issues to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Deliver data-driven findings and recommendations to leadership to support informed decision-making.
  • Support new business initiatives and operational projects by providing advanced configuration expertise and guidance.
Process Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Lead process improvement initiatives that enhance configuration accuracy, operational efficiency, and reimbursement outcomes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to establish and maintain quality standards across contract configuration activities.
  • Participate in quality assurance efforts and promote best practices related to contract configuration and reimbursement methodologies.
Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to Configuration Specialists and team members on contract interpretation, reimbursement methodologies, testing strategies, and configuration best practices.
  • Support onboarding and training efforts to improve team capability and consistency.
  • Foster strong communication and collaboration across departments to ensure timely resolution of issues and successful project outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in contract configuration, provider configuration, reimbursement operations, or claims adjudication within a healthcare payer, managed care organization, IPA, or delegated risk environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise interpreting complex contract terms and translating them into accurate system configurations.
  • Experience leading testing, validation, and quality assurance efforts related to contract configuration and claims outcomes.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex reimbursement and payment integrity issues.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives and operational projects.
License/Certifications
  • Relevant healthcare, reimbursement, business analysis, or configuration certifications preferred but not required.
Technical Knowledge
  • Comprehensive understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, Medi-Cal, RVU, ASA, and other reimbursement methodologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding standards.
  • Experience with healthcare configuration platforms, with EZ-CAP experience strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, and data analysis.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities with a focus on financial accuracy and risk mitigation.
  • Ability to analyze complex reimbursement scenarios and develop effective solutions.
  • Strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting skills.
Communication & Collaboration Skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical information to a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to build productive working relationships across operational, clinical, finance, and technology teams.
Other Competencies
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S.
  • The total compensation target pay range for this role is: $95,000 - $107,500. The salary range represents our national target range for this role.

About Outpace Professional Services
OPS delivers enterprise-grade ERP, automation, and sovereign technology solutions for ambitious businesses that need to move fast without sacrificing quality. From startups to large-scale global operations, we provide the expertise clients need, when they need it, without the overhead of traditional consulting firms.

Our team specialises in Odoo ERP, hyper-automation, systems integration, and operational transformation, helping organisations build scalable, efficient, and fully controlled technology ecosystems.

At OPS, we value agility, transparency, and excellence without ego. We move quickly, solve real problems and focus on delivering measurable impact for every client we work with.

About the Role

Outpace is hiring a Marketing Operations / Campaign Coordinator to keep marketing execution organized, timely, and clean.

This role is the execution and hygiene layer for marketing. You will keep campaigns moving, assets organized, systems clean, deadlines visible, and reporting usable across Growth, RevOps, SDR, Sales, and external partners.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys managing details, building repeatable processes, and turning marketing plans into well-run campaign launches.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the marketing campaign calendar and keep launches, deadlines, assets, approvals, and dependencies visible.
  • Coordinate campaign execution across email, webinars, landing pages, events, paid campaigns, partner campaigns, and content launches.
  • Build and maintain campaign checklists, briefs, launch trackers, asset folders, and reporting templates.
  • Coordinate landing pages, forms, UTMs, tracking links, audience lists, and campaign QA before launch.
  • Partner with RevOps to ensure clean lead source tracking, campaign attribution, routing, and SDR handoff.
  • Support webinar and event logistics, including registration, reminders, speaker coordination, follow-up lists, and post-event reporting.
  • Manage marketing vendors, freelancers, designers, and agencies when needed.
  • Maintain the marketing asset library and make sure sales teams can find the latest approved collateral.
  • Prepare weekly campaign performance snapshots for the Growth Lead and RevOps.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience coordinating B2B marketing campaigns, marketing operations, or revenue marketing projects.
  • Strong project management habits and excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfort working with CRM systems, marketing automation tools, spreadsheets, Notion or other project management tools, and reporting workflows.
  • Ability to operate calmly across many moving pieces without losing details.
  • Clear communication and strong follow-through with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Odoo, Apollo, LinkedIn campaigns, webinar platforms, or similar go-to-market systems.
  • Experience supporting a fast-growing SDR or AE organization.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate briefs, QA, list checks, reporting, and campaign production.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns launch on time and with complete QA.
  • Attribution, UTM, source, and routing hygiene are clean and reliable.
  • Campaign errors, missed handoffs, and outdated collateral are reduced.
  • Marketing, SDR, RevOps, and Sales have better visibility into campaign status and performance.
  • Weekly campaign reporting is consistent, useful, and trusted.

First 90 Days

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Create one source of truth for the marketing calendar.
  • Build campaign templates, launch checklists, and reporting formats.
  • Audit the current campaign tracking and handoff process with RevOps.
  • Organize the first version of the marketing asset library.
  • Support the launch of the first priority campaigns from the Growth Lead.

Success in this role requires more than managing day-to-day operations. You'll develop talent, build high-performing teams, and partner across the business to turn ambiguity into action. raw.description:
The Accounting Services Manager runs a new bookkeeping and accounting practice inside Tax Alchemy, an established tax advisory firm. The position is the primary contact for the practice's clients and the final reviewer of their monthly books. It suits an experienced public accounting manager whose strengths are client service, review discipline, and staff supervision. • Employment: full-time, W-2, exempt • Location: remote, United States • Reports to: President, Tax Alchemy • Oversees: two contract accountants at launch • Authority: client service, staffing, and delivery decisions for the practice, within approved pricing and budget

Key Responsibilities

Client relationships

• Serves as the primary contact for every practice client, from kickoff through monthly delivery.
• Leads onboarding: access, opening balances, cleanup scoping, and the first controlled close.
• Holds scope and pricing conversations, including repricing when entities, volume, or deadlines change.
• Presents monthly financials and resolves client questions and service issues directly. •
Manages engagement letters, recurring invoicing, and collections follow-up for practice clients.

Delivery and review

• Reviews and signs off on every monthly close prepared by the contract accountants.
• Owns the close calendar, client document cutoffs, and on-time delivery.
• Resolves reconciliation exceptions, cleanup issues, and post-close adjustments.
• Coordinates handoffs with Tax Alchemy's tax teams at year-end. Team and process
• Recruits, engages, and replaces contract accountants as client volume requires.
• Assigns, reviews, and coaches the contract accountants' work.
• Writes and maintains the practice's SOPs, checklists, and client communication standards.
• Administers the practice's QuickBooks Online, BILL, and Canopy accounts, including user access and client setups.
• Reports monthly practice KPIs to the President: active clients, recurring revenue, collections, close timeliness, rework, and retention.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Active CPA license in a US state.
• Based in the United States and authorized to work without sponsorship.
• 10 or more years in public accounting, including at least 5 managing bookkeeping, write-up, or client accounting engagements at a CPA or bookkeeping firm.
• Experience managing a book of 25 or more small-business clients as the primary contact, with long-standing client relationships.
• Record of running a client book independently, including scheduling, staffing, and client issue resolution.
• Experience supervising staff accountants or bookkeepers and reviewing the month-end closes they prepare, including remote or contract staff.
• Working proficiency in QuickBooks Online and a payables tool such as BILL.
• Experience onboarding new clients, including cleanup and catch-up work.
• Clear written communication, shown through client emails, review notes, or SOPs.

Preferred qualifications

• QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.
• Long tenure at a small or mid-sized CPA firm, including traditional write-up, payroll, and sales tax compliance work.
• Experience with real estate, multi-entity, or professional services clients.
• Experience working alongside tax preparers or inside a tax firm.
• Experience with Canopy, Tax Alchemy's task management platform, or a comparable practice management tool.
• A record of expanding client engagements through scope and service upgrades.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work
  • Medical, dental, vision, life and voluntary life insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited Paid vacation
  • Paid Sick Days
  • Paid holidays
  • Team-building events

raw.description:
🌟🌩️ VP of Segment & Product Marketing | Denver, USA | Hybrid / Remote

Pax8 is hiring a VP of Segment & Product Marketing in the United States to shape how our next generation of marketplace, managed software and services, managed intelligence, and agentic capabilities are understood, positioned, and brought to market.

🚀 Help define what comes next

This is a rare opportunity to lead at the point where product, artificial intelligence, marketplace innovation and small business growth come together.

You’ll lead our global Segment & Product Marketing function, set the segment strategy that guides where Pax8 focuses, and help turn some of our most important emerging technology into stories customers can understand, believe in, and act on. At the heart of that challenge are 8os and 8bot, alongside our broader agentic capabilities. You’ll work closely with the Product teams to shape clear positioning and compelling use cases and then build adoption plans that prove their value to partners, vendors, and small and midsize businesses.

And you won’t inherit a finished playbook. This is an opportunity to help write it.

☁️ Why Pax8, why now?

The Segment & Product Marketing function is entering a new chapter. The remit has expanded beyond traditional product marketing, with small business moving to the center of our storytelling and a talented team ready for greater clarity, empowerment, and direction.

This is a role for someone who gets excited by transformation and doesn’t wait for everything to be perfectly defined. You’ll join Pax8 as AI reshapes what technology can do, how products reach market, and what customers expect.

🔥 What you’ll take on

You’ll have the scope to:

  • Give 8os and 8bot a voice in the market. Turn complex product vision and technical capability into positioning, value propositions, and use cases that make their value immediately meaningful.
  • Put small business at the heart of the story. Help Pax8 express how our technology creates value across partner, vendor, and small-business workflows.
  • Build a world-class Segment & Product Marketing organization. Give the team a clear North Star, develop its leadership capability, and create the operating rhythm that lets great people perform at their best.
  • Shape strategy, not simply communicate it. Use customer, partner, competitive, and market evidence to influence decisions about product direction, pricing, packaging, investment, and market opportunity.
  • Create launches that land. Set the global approach to commercialization, launch readiness, adoption, and lifecycle growth, and recommend when to launch, delay, or narrow. Bring Product, Sales, and regional teams together around a common direction.
  • Turn insight into decisions. Build a rigorous understanding of buyers, competitors, category change, and AI-driven disruption, then translate it into clear recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Make impact measurable. Connect positioning, launches, and adoption to meaningful commercial outcomes, from engagement and retention through to pipeline, revenue, and expansion. Frequent travel is expected as you connect with global teams, partners, vendors, and industry communities.

🌎 The impact you can make

You’ll influence far more than marketing.

You’ll help determine where Pax8 plays, how our newest products show up in the market, and why customers should care.

You’ll elevate a motivated Segment & Product Marketing team that wants inspirational, hands-on leadership, while creating stronger connections across Product, Sales, Partners, Vendors, and Studios.

Most importantly, you’ll help turn powerful technology such as 8os and 8bot from technical capability into clear, credible customer value.

🧠 You’ll be ideal for us if you

  • Bring substantial leadership experience across business-to-business technology, product marketing, segment marketing, solution marketing, or go-to-market strategy in a complex, matrixed global organization.
  • Have proven experience building or significantly transforming a Segment & Product Marketing function.
  • Have a record of positioning and commercializing complex platforms, marketplaces, AI-enabled products, automation, cloud, or adjacent technology, with measurable results in adoption and growth.
  • Are genuinely fluent in artificial intelligence and agentic technology and can move comfortably from technical capability to buyer problem, differentiated proposition, and adoption strategy.
  • Can take something highly complex and make it remarkably simple without stripping away what matters.
  • Use market and customer evidence to influence consequential decisions around portfolio direction, roadmaps, packaging, pricing, and investment.
  • Can challenge assumptions constructively and influence senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, Digital, and customer-facing organizations.
  • Bring strong commercial judgment and are comfortable recommending where to accelerate, where to rethink, and sometimes where not to invest.
  • Bring an independent point of view, curiosity, and the confidence to operate through ambiguity rather than waiting to be handed the answer.

🤝 How we hire

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust-based relationships — starting with how we hire.

To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you’re applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we’re excited to meet you.

We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritizing applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.

💜 Bring what makes you different

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. We’re committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring, and sharing your transferable skills. To fulfill this role, you must hold a valid right to work in the United States.

💰 Total Rewards

At Pax8 we believe that your Total Rewards should include a benefits package that shows how much we value our greatest assets. All FTE Pax8 people enjoy the following benefits:

  • Qualified candidates can expect a salary up to $285,000.00 PA depending on experience
  • 401(k) with Company Match

  • Flexible Open PTO

🏔️ Life at Pax8 Denver

  • Amazing location at the heart of Denver Tech Center.
  • Views directly into Fiddlers Green Amphitheatre with the occasional sound check concert midday.
  • Breathtaking Colorado mountain view from over half the office.
  • Spacious sit-to-stand desks, state-of-the-art 34-inch curved screens, and cell phone chargers.
  • Cafe Eight barista bar to fuel bodies and ideas.
  • State-of-the-art Top Brewer Coffee Machines.
  • Mini Market with a curated selection of grab-and-go snacks and a beverage fridge.
  • Large communal lunch area with catered lunch twice a week.
  • Wellness rooms for both body and mind.
  • Games area with arcade games, a ping pong table, and high-energy music.
  • Regular social, cultural, and networking events.
  • Building Amenities: curated art gallery and elevated fitness center.

The position supports hybrid or remote working, with Denver and the San Francisco Bay Area among the identified locations for the role.

🌟 We want to hear from you

If you find it hard to get time out during the day, we’re happy to arrange early or late conversations and interview times. If you have any questions, you can call Lou Crossman, the Talent Partner managing this role from the UK, on +44 117 205 0234. No agencies, please.


🌱 What’s in it for you?

There’s extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that’s advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organization. You’ll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you’ll also tap into AI-powered tools, “born in the cloud” mentors, and cross-continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We’ll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.

☁️ About Pax8

Our mission is to build the managed intelligence marketplace and empower small businesses to do more with smarter technology. We are a fast-growing, dynamic, and high-energy organization with a start-up feel, allowing you to make a meaningful impact on the business.


💜 The Behaviors & Values That Power Pax8

Culture is important to us, and at Pax8, it’s business, and it IS personal. We are passionate, creative, and unconventional. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best! We Elev8 each other. We Advoc8 for our partners. We Innov8 continuously. We Celebr8 life.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Technical Program Manager, Product & Technology Strategic Partnerships, you will be tasked with orchestrating engineering and platform-integration work for the strategic partnership within Product & Technology. You will connect product teams, engineering owners, technology workstreams, and partner technical coordinators into a measurable plan, from design decision through integration, testing, cutover, and ongoing change. This role is distinct from business operations project management: it owns engineering-facing dependencies, technical decision tracking, and durable delivery from the Product & Technology side.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Drive the Product & Technology integration workplan with engineering milestones, technical dependencies, design reviews, and readiness gates.
  • Coordinate platform, API, identity/access, data-flow, telemetry, and tooling requirements with appropriate engineering and security owners.
  • Work alongside the business Technology & Tooling Project Manager to align technical execution with operational rollout and partner readiness.
  • Facilitate solution reviews, engineering prioritization discussions, integration tests, and cross-team issue resolution.
  • Track technical blockers, design tradeoffs, production risks, and releases that could affect partner service delivery.
  • Establish acceptance criteria, test evidence, rollback expectations, and ownership for platform integrations and changes.
  • Ensure change-control and security approval requirements are respected throughout engineering execution.
  • Build concise status reports and decision escalations for Product & Technology leaders and the partnership program.
  • Transition completed integrations into supported operating models with documentation, monitoring, and named maintainers.
  • Be measured by on-time engineering and platform integration milestones; accurate and timely reporting on program status; technical cutover and access readiness with approved quality/security gates; fewer integration defects and production handoff issues; and transparent and effective management of engineering risks and dependencies.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5 or more years of technical program or project management experience working directly with engineering, platform, or product delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with SaaS software development lifecycles, APIs, system integrations, cloud services, and engineering dependencies.
  • Ability to understand architecture tradeoffs and translate technical concerns into clear plans and stakeholder decisions.
  • Experience with requirements, release management, technical testing, change control, and incident follow-up.
  • Strong cross-functional coordination and written communication across engineers, security, product, and business operations.
  • Proficiency with engineering tracking tools and technical documentation methods.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity, drive decisions, and maintain momentum without direct managerial authority.
  • Experience with SaaS cybersecurity platforms, telemetry, cloud security, or developer-facing APIs is highly desirable.
  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, or systems integration is highly desirable.
  • Experience with enterprise partner integrations and post-launch operational readiness is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. We are engaging principal-level engineers, scientists, and faculty to design the technical problems that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain expertise is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

We’re building this across four areas: aerospace, semiconductors, manufacturing and industrial engineering, and materials science. If your work sits in one of those — or across two of them — this is for you.

raw.description:
Lightship is a clinical trial site organization delivering on-site, hybrid, and virtual trials through a single, trusted partner. Our expanded reach model places each visit in the most practical setting, increasing access, strengthening enrollment and engagement, and improving representation across diverse communities.

Position Summary

The Senior Clinical Data Manager is responsible for leading all data management activities across one or more clinical trials from study start-up through database lock and study closeout. This role ensures the collection, validation, integrity, and quality of clinical trial data in compliance with protocol requirements, ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory standards, and company SOPs. The Senior Clinical Data Manager serves as the primary data management lead for assigned studies and collaborates closely with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Monitoring, Safety, Sponsors, CRO partners, and technology vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Study Management & Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end clinical data management activities for assigned studies.
  • Develop and maintain Data Management Plans (DMPs), Data Validation Plans, and study-specific data review strategies.
  • Participate in protocol review to ensure data collection requirements support study endpoints and operational execution.
  • Provide data management leadership during study start-up, conduct, database lock, and study closeout activities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsor and cross-functional data management discussions.

Database Design & Development

  • Lead CRF/eCRF design and review to ensure accurate and efficient data collection.
  • Collaborate with EDC developers to build, test, and validate study databases.
  • Review database specifications, edit checks, derivations, and integration requirements.
  • Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure all study requirements are met prior to go-live.
  • Design workflows supporting virtual, hybrid, and decentralized study models.

Data Review & Quality Management

  • Develop and implement data cleaning and review strategies.
  • Perform ongoing data review to identify trends, inconsistencies, and quality concerns.
  • Lead query management activities and ensure timely query resolution.
  • Review protocol deviations, missing data, and key risk indicators impacting data quality.
  • Monitor data quality metrics and provide regular status reporting.

Vendor & External Data Management

  • Oversee integration and reconciliation of external data sources including, but not limited to:
  • Central laboratories
  • Imaging vendors
  • ePRO/eCOA systems
  • Wearable devices and digital health technologies
  • Safety databases
  • Ensure timely receipt, validation, and reconciliation of external datasets.
  • Coordinate with vendors to resolve data discrepancies and integration issues.

Database Lock & Study Closeout

  • Lead database lock planning and execution.
  • Facilitate data review meetings and lock readiness assessments.
  • Ensure all reconciliation activities are completed prior to lock.
  • Coordinate final data transfer to Biostatistics and other stakeholders.
  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, and sponsor reviews.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner effectively with Clinical Operations, Medical Monitoring, Safety, Vendors, and Sponsors.
  • Contribute pragmatic data management solutions that balance startup speed, operational feasibility, quality, and budget considerations.

Additional responsibilities, as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Health Informatics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or related field required.
  • Advanced degree preferred.

Experience

  • 7+ years of clinical data management experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, or clinical research environments.
  • Experience leading data management activities for Phase I-IV clinical trials.
  • Experience with decentralized, hybrid, or digital clinical trials preferred.
  • Prior sponsor-facing leadership experience strongly preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with EDC systems such as Medrio, Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault CDMS, Oracle InForm, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of CDISC standards, including SDTM and controlled terminology.
  • Experience with external data integrations and reconciliation processes.
  • Experience participating in study startup activities, including protocol review, data collection strategy development, and EDC implementation
  • Knowledge of clinical trial regulations, including ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and applicable global requirements.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting capabilities.

Competencies

  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple studies and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Experience for Decentralized Clinical Trials

  • Experience overseeing data from remote and virtual trial technologies.
  • Experience with diagnostic-device or diagnostic-assay clinical studies preferred.
  • Familiarity with participant-centric data collection methodologies.
  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed research sites and mobile research teams.

Success Measures

  • Timely database builds and study start-up deliverables.
  • Achievement of database lock timelines.
  • High-quality, audit-ready clinical data.
  • Reduction in data query aging and resolution timelines.
  • Strong sponsor satisfaction and stakeholder engagement.
  • Successful management of multiple concurrent studies while maintaining quality standards.
  • Successful management and reconciliation of internal and external clinical data sources while maintaining data quality and inspection readiness.

Während wir international wachsen und unsere Technologie weiterentwickeln, bleibt Arctic Wolf der vertrauenswürdigste Name in der Branche.

Unser Erfolg entsteht dadurch, dass wir unsere Kunden begeistern – und dafür ziehen wir alle an einem Strang. About Mason Private Locating

Mason Private Locating (MPL) is a Midwest-based underground utility services company providing specialized solutions to protect underground infrastructure and support construction projects. Our services include Private Utility Locating, Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE), Vacuum Excavation, Sewer Camera Inspections, Concrete Scanning, and Traffic Control.

MPL is committed to delivering quality service, building strong customer relationships, and utilizing industry expertise and advanced technology to provide dependable solutions to our customers.

Position Summary

Mason Private Locating is seeking an experienced and results-driven Vice President of Business Development to lead and expand our business development operations across multiple markets.

This executive leadership position is responsible for driving revenue and gross margin growth, developing and managing a high-performing sales team, expanding our presence in strategic growth markets, and strengthening customer relationships throughout our established Midwest territories.

The Vice President of Business Development will oversee all inside and outside business development personnel, establish sales strategies and performance expectations, develop new business opportunities, and work closely with operations and executive leadership to ensure profitable growth and exceptional customer service.

The ideal candidate is a strategic sales leader with a proven ability to build teams, develop markets, generate new business, and deliver measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Business Growth

  • Develop and execute business development strategies to increase revenue and gross margin across all assigned markets.
  • Drive expansion in key growth markets, including Florida, Texas, Chicago/Northwest Indiana, while continuing to strengthen MPL's Midwest presence.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities and strategic customer relationships.
  • Develop and execute initiatives to re-engage and win back inactive and former customers.
  • Personally manage and maintain relationships with key accounts and strategic customers.
  • Establish sales goals, territories, activity expectations, and performance standards for the business development team.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead, manage, and develop all inside and outside business development personnel across assigned territories.
  • Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, train, coach, and evaluate business development team members.
  • Establish accountability through regular performance reviews, sales meetings, and measurable performance expectations.
  • Address performance concerns and administer appropriate disciplinary action in accordance with company policies.
  • Build a strong, results-oriented sales culture focused on accountability, customer relationships, and profitable growth.

Sales Operations & Performance Management

  • Oversee the sales pipeline and ensure accurate, timely documentation within HubSpot CRM.
  • Monitor estimate and proposal follow-up to maximize sales opportunities and conversion rates.
  • Maintain pricing discipline and ensure sales activities align with established company pricing guidelines and gross margin expectations.
  • Track sales performance, customer acquisition, pipeline activity, quote-to-close ratios, and overall team productivity.
  • Prepare and present weekly and monthly sales performance reports to executive leadership.
  • Monitor collected revenue and customer payment status as part of overall sales performance accountability.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Partner with Operations, Dispatch, and Estimating to coordinate pricing, scheduling, project delivery, and customer expectations.
  • Ensure business development commitments align with operational capabilities and company profitability objectives.
  • Communicate market opportunities, competitive trends, and customer feedback to executive leadership.
  • Gather competitive and market intelligence through appropriate and legitimate business practices.
  • Represent MPL at customer meetings, networking opportunities, and industry events.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven experience in business development, sales leadership, or a related executive-level position.
  • Experience in utility locating, damage prevention, underground construction, utility services, or a related industry strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading, developing, and managing sales teams across multiple geographic territories.
  • Proven ability to develop new markets, generate revenue, improve gross margins, and establish long-term customer relationships.
  • Strong understanding of sales pipelines, CRM systems, sales forecasting, and performance reporting. HubSpot experience preferred.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to establish accountability, motivate teams, and drive results in a performance-based environment.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel throughout the United States as business needs require.

Travel Requirements

This position requires domestic travel based on business needs, including travel to assigned markets, team locations, customer meetings, and industry events. Travel frequency will vary depending on business priorities.

What We Offer

  • Competitive executive compensation package.
  • Opportunity to lead and shape a growing business development organization.
  • Direct involvement in strategic company growth and market expansion.
  • Collaborative working environment with executive leadership.
  • Opportunity to make a measurable impact on company performance and long-term growth.

Join Mason Private Locating and help lead our next phase of growth!

raw.description:
We're looking for a Direct Response Video Editor to produce short-form video ads for a boutique agency that helps brands grow on Amazon. You will take scripts from the team, review them, and build finished 45 to 60 second ads by assembling B-roll and voiceover into videos made to hold attention and drive action.

This is a direct response role, not a brand video role. The ad is judged on results: whether the hook stops the scroll, whether the pacing keeps people watching, and whether the offer and call to action land. You will work under the head of growth, who oversees the editing work, and you will be part of a team that only hires people who are detail-obsessed and highly driven. Scripts are provided, so your job is to make them work on screen quickly and cleanly. If you have a portfolio of ads that were built to convert, you catch the small details others miss, and you want to work at a fast pace, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires working 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday
  • Work directly under the head of growth, with clear direction and fast feedback
  • High-output role on ads where performance data shows exactly what your work is doing

What You'll Work On

Direct Response Ad Production

  • Edit short-form direct response video ads of about 45 to 60 seconds each
  • Review each script before you begin and flag anything unclear or unworkable early
  • Assemble B-roll and voiceover into finished ads with tight pacing and clear structure
  • Build strong hooks, clean transitions, captions, and on-screen text that support the message

Quality and Detail

  • Check every video for errors in timing, audio, captions, text, and product visuals before delivery
  • Keep ads consistent with the script, the offer, and the brand's look
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and accurately without repeating mistakes

Workflow and Delivery

  • Deliver finished ads in the correct formats and specifications for each platform
  • Organize project files and assets so edits can be revised or repurposed quickly
  • Keep a steady pace of output and communicate early if a deadline is at risk
  • Work with the head of growth to learn which hooks, formats, and edits perform best

Requirements

What You Bring

  • A portfolio showing direct response or performance video ads you have edited; this is required to apply
  • Strong editing skills in a tool such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar
  • A good sense of pacing, hooks, and what holds attention in short-form ads
  • Experience working from scripts and combining B-roll and voiceover into a finished video
  • High attention to detail, including timing, captions, audio, and visuals
  • High drive, fast turnaround, and ownership of your work without chasing
  • Clear written English for feedback and coordination
  • Available to work 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing ads for ecommerce, Amazon, or consumer product brands
  • Experience with Amazon video ad formats or Meta and TikTok ad creative
  • Experience using performance data to improve hooks and edits
  • Experience with AI voiceover, AI B-roll, or AI-assisted editing tools
  • Experience with captions, motion graphics, and basic sound design

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link with at least 4 to 6 direct response or performance ads you have edited
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself and walking through one ad you edited, including the hook, the pacing choices, and how you checked it for errors before delivery

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are detail-obsessed, move fast, and want to edit ads where the results show up in the numbers, this role gives you the pace and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Engineering team
The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to run the Payment Instruments team, which owns how payment methods are created, maintained, monitored and kept compliant globally, from cards and ACH to Apple Pay and new methods in global markets. You’ll grow engineers, set clear technical direction, and deliver reliable, trusted payments that advance our mission of honest financial products.

What you’ll do

  • You will lead and grow the engineers who build, maintain and monitor Affirm’s global payment methods, from cards and ACH to Apple Pay and new methods in new markets.

  • You will set a clear technical roadmap that turns Consumer Payments goals into executable plans, and keep the team focused on the highest-impact priorities.

  • You will hire, develop and retain engineers at every level, with clear career paths and a high bar for craft, reliability and impact.

  • You will partner with product, design, risk, compliance and other engineering teams to ship new payment methods and expand into new markets with speed and quality.

  • You will make sure payment methods stay healthy and compliant by championing standards for reliability, performance, security and regulatory requirements.

  • You will guide the team in improving a long-standing codebase step by step, so that each project leaves the platform simpler and stronger.

  • You will foster a culture of ownership and curiosity, where the team uses AI-assisted tools and measures its impact.

What we look for

  • You bring the experience and mindset to lead a team that moves money for millions of people.

  • You have 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading and growing engineering teams.

  • You have a track record of shipping and scaling consumer-facing payments or fintech systems.

  • You are experienced in building and developing teams, including ramping up new joiners, and you create clarity in ambiguous situations.

  • You are a strong partner who can influence and align peers and stakeholders across product, design, risk and compliance.

  • You have experience with compliance, regulatory or multi-market requirements, and you appreciate how they shape system design.

  • You are adaptable to change and make sound technical trade-offs when priorities shift.

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 7

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidised medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

Base pay range per year: £142,000 - £190,000

Location: UK Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

raw.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Own The Space (OTS) is a campaign accelerator and sister organisation of Led By Donkeys.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Own The Space (OTS) is a campaign accelerator and sister organisation of Led By Donkeys. We build campaign teams around projects we believe can have a positive impact in the world, then develop and scale them. Our leadership team has decades of experience incubating and growing campaigns and organisations.

Together For Palestine (T4P) creates landmark cultural events that bring together artists, cultural figures and audiences together in solidarity. Following the first concert in London, the project is now developing a large-scale benefit show in New York in 2027, to raise funds for Palestinian causes and bring the call for justice and freedom to a global audience.

We care passionately about the areas we engage in and pursue projects that have a high level of ambition coupled with the potential to deliver change quickly. An activist organisation at its heart, we are in our fourth year with ambitious plans for the future.

About the role

This is a new role and our first CFO. You will lead OTS’s finances and advise the Directors on financial strategy, while also being closely involved in the day-to-day work. We are a small organisation, so the role combines senior responsibility with practical delivery.

You will work with our external accountants, who provide bookkeeping, payroll and statutory accounts, and with the Directors and Project Directors who lead our campaigns.

OTS operates across a for-profit limited company and a not-for-profit company, and works closely with related organisations. Essential to this role is an in-depth understanding of grants, individual donations and commercial contracts, including tax, reporting and compliance requirements.

The role reports to the Directors.

Key responsibilities

Financial strategy

  • Develop financial models and multi-year forecasts that support planning and decision-making

  • Advise the Directors on financial risk, funding strategy and the financial implications of new projects

  • Establish and maintain clear financial arrangements between entities, including intercompany agreements, recharges, cost sharing and overheads

  • Maintain finance policies, including overheads, expenses, intercompany transfers and payments

Funding and tax

  • Review grant agreements, donations and contracts, and advise on their structure, reporting requirements and tax treatment

  • Ensure restricted funds are managed and reported in line with funder requirements

  • Manage and monitor the VAT position of both entities, including advising on the treatment of different types of income

  • Draft and oversee the drafting of budgets and financial information for funding applications

Financial management and reporting

  • Produce monthly management accounts and financial reporting for the Directors, working with the external accountants

  • Own the spending guardrails: monitor and enforce them across the organisation while driving the build-up of reserves to target

  • Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process

  • Oversee cash flow, payment processes and financial controls

  • Ensure compliance with HMRC, Companies House and pension requirements

Working with the Team

  • Manage the relationship with our external accountants

  • Support Project Directors to develop and manage their project budgets

  • Help build financial understanding across the organisation

  • Advise on operational matters with financial implications, including contracts, employment arrangements and insurance

  • Work with the operations team to make sure systems, policies and processes work well together


Requirements

About you

Essential

  • A professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or equivalent experience

  • Experience in the charity, campaigning or wider not-for-profit sector

  • Hands-on development and delivery of internal processes

  • A strong understanding of grants, donations and funding agreements, and the related tax implications, including VAT

  • Experience managing finances across more than one entity, ideally including both for-profit and not-for-profit

  • Strong skills in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, financial controls and management accounts

  • The ability to explain financial information clearly to non-specialists

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to advise senior leaders

  • Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, Pleo and Google Drive

Desirable

  • Experience leading finance in a start-up or small organisation

  • Experience of international funding

  • Experience working across multiple project types, including events and campaigns

  • Experience in strategic operations, such as organisational development, HR or contract management

This role suits someone who is comfortable working in a small team where systems are still developing, and who is happy to take on both strategic and practical work.


Benefits

Benefits

  • This is a one year FTC with a strong possibility of extension.

  • Own The Space uses a fixed pay scale based on organisational level. To ensure equity, salaries are non-negotiable. This role pays £86,940 pro-rata.

  • Benefits include 35 days annual leave, pro-rata (inclusive of public holidays and grace days) and 6% pension scheme.

  • This is a fully remote role

  • The role may involve regular travel to London or Bristol, approx every 2 months, with trips sometimes involving an overnight stay.

  • We believe people do their best work when they have time for their families and lives outside work. We actively encourage this, and we’re open to discussing flexible working arrangements.

Equity, Inclusion and Diversity

We know that diverse teams lead to better outcomes and each new hire is a chance for Own the Space to bring in new perspectives and approaches. We welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation and cultural identity. We aim for Own The Space to be a welcoming, supportive and creative place to work.

We make our recruitment accessible to any and all people. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at .

Please submit one document which includes (1)your CVand (2)one paragraph onlyoutlining your suitability for the role. Applications without a paragraph will not be considered.
