raw.description:
Kleos is a fast-growing HR&Global payroll platform that helps companies hire, manage, and pay international teams. We simplify global payroll, CoR and EoR services, cross-border payments, make international operations easier, faster, and more compliant.

Today, 600+ companies use Kleos to manage their global teams across 200+ countries, with over $100M in payments processed through our platform.

We’re looking for an EoR Operations Manager to own the day-to-day operations of our EoR product — from employee onboarding and coordination with local partners to mobility support, invoicing, and monthly payroll reconciliation. You’ll ensure smooth processes, accurate documentation, and timely payments while keeping clients and partners informed.

What You'll Do

EoR onboarding, offboarding and client support

  • Manage client requests to hire employees in new countries, providing guidance on local employment requirements, timelines, and processes.

  • Prepare employment cost calculations and coordinate approvals with clients.

  • Work closely with local EoR partners to confirm onboarding requirements and collect the necessary documentation.

  • Prepare and verify employment application forms, ensuring all information is complete and accurate.

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process, coordinating next steps and keeping clients and partners updated.

  • Coordinate employee offboarding, advising clients on country-specific termination requirements, timelines, and associated costs, including final payments and any applicable compensation.

Employee mobility and visa support

  • Coordinate employee relocation and visa-related requests with local partners.

  • Calculate mobility costs, prepare estimates, and agree on expenses and timelines with clients.

  • Collect and verify required documentation based on the employee's and their family's circumstances.

  • Coordinate mobility-related invoicing and track progress throughout the process.

Invoicing and payment reconciliation

  • Prepare and coordinate invoices for employee onboarding, mobility, and related services.

  • Track invoice and deposit payments, maintain accurate records, and follow up on outstanding amounts.

  • Manage month-end reconciliations by comparing client charges with actual invoices from local partners.

  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies, including adjustments for bonuses and additional payments.

  • Ensure all financial data is accurately recorded in the platform and confirmed with clients.

Monthly payroll operations

  • Maintain monthly EoR payroll invoicing trackers and ensure all relevant information is up to date.

  • Coordinate the preparation and issuance of monthly payroll invoices

  • Work with local partners and internal teams to ensure payroll-related charges are accurate and processed on time.

Partner coordination and operational improvements

  • Build effective working relationships with local EoR partners and ensure smooth communication across countries.

  • Act as the main operational contact for clients throughout the EoR lifecycle.

  • Identify process gaps and opportunities to improve operational efficiency, accuracy, and client experience.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Support the Sales team with country-specific onboarding requirements, timelines, and guidance on client communication.

  • Act as a bridge between Finance, Legal, and Sales teams to align employment requirements, costs, documentation, and operational processes.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in HR Operations or EoR Operations, with hands-on experience in international markets.

  • Experience in EoR operations/ HR operations global employment, international payroll, or a similar operational role involving cross-border employment processes.

  • Understanding of international employment processes, including employee onboarding, local employment requirements, and working with third-party providers.

  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, including clients, external partners, and internal teams.

  • Strong experience with invoicing, payment tracking, financial reconciliation, and working with detailed financial data.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Strong ownership mindset and a proactive approach to solving operational issues.

  • Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex processes to clients.

  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, operational trackers, and financial systems.

  • Fluent English and Russian for daily communication with international clients and partners.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work — work from wherever you're most productive, with working hours aligned with the CET time zone.

  • Real ownership — take responsibility for key operational processes within our growing EoR product.

  • International exposure — work with clients and partners across different countries and markets.

  • Direct impact — help improve how we deliver and scale our global employment services.

  • A fast-growing environment — join a team where decisions are made quickly, ideas are valued, and your work makes a visible difference.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Receivable Associate with HeadQuarters, you will be responsible for managing and monitoring receivables, preparing and processing invoices, and supporting customers with billing-related inquiries and account matters. We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized professional with excellent English and strong communication skills who is comfortable working with numbers and financial information and is ready to grow in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

We are currently looking for two new team members for different clients based on the East and West Coast, with working hours of 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST and 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, respectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collections & Aging Management: Manage and maintain aged accounts receivable across wholesale retail accounts, ensuring timely collection efforts and resolution of delinquent balances.
  • Proactive Follow-Up: Monitor aging reports and proactively follow up on upcoming and past-due invoices through phone calls, emails, and written correspondence while maintaining accurate documentation of all account activity, customer communication, and collection efforts.
  • Dispute Resolution: Investigate, resolve, and reconcile account discrepancies, invoice disputes, deductions, short payments, and unapplied cash in a timely and professional manner.
  • Payment Processing: Process, apply, and reconcile customer payments and credit memos accurately within Dynamics and Acumatica ERP systems.
  • Credit Risk Monitoring: Monitor customer credit risk, review payment trends, assist with payment term requests, and support credit reviews for new and existing retail accounts.
  • Sales Partnership: Partner with sales personnel to manage customer accounts, review credit limits, enforce credit holds on delinquent accounts, and balance collections priorities with customer relationship management.
  • Account Reconciliation: Perform account reconciliations and support retail partners with statement reviews, payment research, and dispute resolution.
  • Risk Escalation: Identify delinquent or high-risk accounts and recommend payment arrangements, escalations, third-party collections, or legal action when necessary.
  • Reporting: Maintain accurate account records and prepare reporting related to AR aging, account status, collections activity, and critical account updates.
  • Leadership Engagement: Participate in weekly meetings with the CFO and Financial Controller to provide updates on critical accounts, collection risks, and overall AR performance.

Qualifications:

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Previous experience in billing, finance, accounting, collections, customer support, or a similar role is a plus.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with numbers, data, and financial information.
  • Experience working with ERP systems is a plus; familiarity with Dynamics or Acumatica is an advantage.

Benefits

🌍 Work fully remotely in a flexible and collaborative environment

💼 Build your expertise in Accounts Receivable while supporting leading U.S. cannabis companies

📈 Grow your career through hands-on experience, ownership, and continuous learning

Our Values
We are guided by curiosity, collaboration, and persistence. We seek to understand deeply, work collectively to solve complex challenges, and remain resilient in pursuit of meaningful, long-term impact. These principles shape how we operate as a team and how we support the success of our clients.

👉Take a look at this short video 🎥 featuring a few words from the CEO about our company, industry insights, and founding HQ!

Looking forward to meeting you!

raw.description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

In the role of Senior Product Manager you will leverage deep security expertise to collaborate with forward-thinking engineers and excited customers to ensure we have the most competitive and relevant cybersecurity solutions for service providers and enterprise customers. You will work with the executive team to establish a winning strategy, and partner with our outstanding sales, and marketing to ensure market adoption and rapid growth.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for EDR and XDR platforms and beyond, aligning with business goals and customer needs.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through the full product lifecycle - from ideation and research to launch and iterative improvement.
  • Translate complex security requirements and threat intelligence into clear, actionable product specifications and user stories.
  • Collaborate with threat researchers and engineers to integrate cutting-edge detection logic, automation, and response capabilities.
  • Champion a customer-first mindset, using feedback from enterprise clients, support teams, and field engineers to prioritize features and improvements.
  • Work with sales and marketing to craft compelling messaging, demos, and go-to-market strategies for new capabilities.
  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends (e.g., AI-driven security, zero trust, cloud-native defense) to keep our products ahead of the curve.
  • Measure product success through KPIs including adoption, detection accuracy, mean time to respond, customer satisfaction, and retention.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on cybersecurity, threat detection, or security operations.
  • Deep understanding of EDR/XDR attack vectors, customer scenarios, and security workflows.
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling security products in enterprise environments.
  • Ability to dive deep in technology and to convey complex ideas simply and clearly in written and verbal formats, including public speaking, demos and content development.
  • Working proficiency level of English, both written and verbal

Nice to have

  • Specific knowledge of MSP business models and the automation of their processes in service delivery. Additional knowledge of providers and B2B IT services highly desirable.

*Please submit your resume and application in English.


WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.

OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.

Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks.


Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

raw.description:
About the Role:

Whistle is an international B2B Go-To-Market (GTM) agency helping tech companies scale their revenue engines through practical, no-fluff content built specifically for sales and marketing leaders around the world. We are looking for a skilled Video Editor to take raw recordings, including talking-head videos, podcast-style conversations, screen shares, and call breakdowns, and transform them into engaging, high-retention videos that our audience actually finishes watching. You will own the post-production process from rough footage to upload-ready files, as well as repurpose each long-form video into high-impact Shorts and clips for LinkedIn.

What You'll Do:

  • Long-Form Editing: Edit raw footage for tight pacing and clarity—cutting the waffle while keeping the substance.
  • Visual Enhancement: Add dynamic captions, lower thirds, B-roll, simple motion graphics, and on-screen text to make dense B2B sales and marketing topics easy to follow.
  • Short-Form Repurposing: Identify key moments and produce 2 to 3 vertical clips from every long-form video tailored for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.
  • Packaging & Optimization: Design eye-catching thumbnails and craft compelling, honest titles, SEO-friendly descriptions, and relevant timestamps that drive clicks without clickbait.
  • Brand & Asset Management: Maintain a consistent visual identity using Whistle's brand assets, organize and manage a shared footage library, and maintain predictable turnaround times.
  • Performance-Driven Iteration: Review channel analytics with the team monthly (retention curves, click-through rate, and drop-off points) and apply those insights to continuously refine your editing approach.

Monthly Deliverables:

  • 4 x Long-Form YouTube Videos (maximum 20 minutes each), fully uploaded and optimized with searchable headlines, keyword-rich descriptions, custom thumbnails, and timestamps.
  • 8 - 12 x Short-Form Vertical Clips (2–3 clips per long-form video) formatted for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.
  • 1 x Monthly Channel Performance Report summarizing key metrics and actionable takeaways for future edits.

What Were Looking For:

  • Proven Experience: At least 2 years of experience editing YouTube content, ideally for a business or B2B channel, backed by a strong portfolio.
  • Platform Fluency:A clear understanding of what holds viewer attention on YouTube and how pacing and hooks differ on LinkedIn.
  • Editorial Instinct:The ability to watch a 40-minute conversation and independently spot the 45 seconds worth clipping.
  • Reliability & Communication:Strong time management skills—you hit your deadlines and communicate early if a timeline is ever at risk of slipping.
  • Nice to Have: Basic graphic/thumbnail design skills & Familiarity with YouTube SEO best practices.

raw.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

You'll be part of the Sphera AI Center of Excellence team building and maturing the AI capabilities that Sphera and its customers depend on. You will design and ship AI agents and AI-powered features used across product families and internal functions, and act as the expert other teams come to when they want to build with AI themselves.


We build on Claude and deploy on Azure AI Foundry, with Claude Code as our primary development environment. The pace is fast, prototype to production in weeks, not quarters, so you'll apply the skills you have while learning new ones constantly. If you have hands-on experience shipping LLM-based systems and enjoy unblocking other engineers, you'll do well here.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain production AI agents and AI-powered features — new builds as well as enhancements to existing solutions.
  • Build and sustain agentic systems end to end: task decomposition, tool design, context and memory strategy, orchestration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback behavior.
  • Build the retrieval and grounding layer — document processing, chunking, hybrid search, and citation — so agents answer from Sphera's own data.
  • Deploy and operate AI workloads on Azure AI Foundry: model deployments, endpoints, content safety, private networking, and cost and quota management.
  • Use Claude Code as a core engineering tool and set the patterns other teams follow when they do the same.
  • Own evaluation: build eval suites and golden datasets, measure accuracy, latency, cost, and tool-call correctness, and gate changes on results.
  • Implement AI guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, and PII handling, working with Platform Engineering on identity and network controls.
  • Ship through CI/CD with versioned prompts and agent definitions, plus tracing and token/cost observability on every path.
  • Support teams adopting shared AI services — review their designs, troubleshoot integrations, and document reusable patterns.
  • Establish KPIs for adoption, quality, and cost-per-outcome, and use them to drive improvement and make the team's impact visible.
  • Participate fully in the agile process — own your sprint tasks, log time worked, and keep details current.

Required Skills and Experience

AI Engineering

  • 4–6 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building with large language models in production.
  • Hands-on experience shipping agentic systems: multi-step tool use, structured outputs, state and memory, error recovery — and the judgment to know when an agent isn't the right answer.
  • Working command of Claude or a comparable frontier model platform, including APIs, tool use, and agent SDKs.
  • Practical daily use of AI-assisted development tooling, Claude Code in particular.
  • Retrieval engineering: embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality on its own terms.
  • Evaluation and observability for non-deterministic systems — offline evals, human review loops, tracing, and cost instrumentation.

Software and Cloud

  • Strong Python, plus one of TypeScript, C#, or Java.
  • Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI — model deployment, endpoint configuration, and content safety controls.
  • Azure fundamentals: App Service or Function Apps, Key Vault, Storage, Entra ID managed identities, and Application Insights.
  • CI/CD with Azure DevOps — YAML pipelines, multi-stage deployments, and secret management.
  • REST and async API design, and integration with enterprise systems of record.
  • Databases (SQL and NoSQL) and vector stores; solid Git and code review practice.

Professional

  • Sound security judgment applied to AI — least privilege for tool access, secrets management, data exfiltration risk, and compliance-driven controls.
  • Excellent communication, with the ability to explain AI design decisions and trade-offs to people who are not AI specialists.
  • Experience working in an agile AIDLC (AI-driven software development lifecycle) in a fast-paced environment with high demand and high standards.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building tools and connectors that give models governed access to internal systems.
  • AI features in a commercial SaaS product, including multi-tenant and data-isolation concerns.
  • Document AI and unstructured data extraction at volume.
  • Classical ML or fine-tuning background — enough to know when a smaller or non-LLM approach wins.
  • Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or comparable data orchestration tooling.
  • AI governance frameworks — EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or ISO 42001.
  • Domain exposure to EHS, sustainability, ESG, or industrial risk.
  • Relevant certifications (AI-102, AZ-204, or similar).

Sphera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all colleagues.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position.

Senior SailPoint IdentityIQ Workflow Engineer

Summary

We are seeking an experienced professional to lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex identity management workflows within the IT Services sector. This pivotal role focuses on optimizing Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies, ensuring seamless integration across diverse enterprise applications, and maintaining robust security protocols for identity lifecycles. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence by managing production support, troubleshooting intricate issues, and implementing advanced automation solutions using SailPoint IdentityIQ. This position is critical for organizations managing large-scale user provisioning and access governance, requiring a deep understanding of both technical architecture and business continuity needs.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and configure sophisticated workflow processes, including transitions and subprocesses, utilizing Workflow XML to align with organizational security policies.
  • Develop and maintain custom logic using BeanShell scripting and Java to extend SailPoint capabilities for complex provisioning scenarios.
  • Manage the full Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) processes, ensuring accurate execution of AccountRequests and AttributeRequests.
  • Oversee the creation and optimization of ProvisioningPlans to facilitate efficient user access across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, Salesforce, and SAP environments.
  • Lead production support activities, performing root cause analysis and resolution for critical identity management issues to minimize downtime.
  • Implement and manage Identity Governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and internal audit requirements.
  • Design and execute REST API integrations, specifically focusing on connectivity with ServiceNow and other enterprise service platforms.
  • Collaborate with security teams to integrate CyberArk solutions for privileged access management within the broader IAM ecosystem.
  • Write and maintain SailPoint Rules to enforce granular provisioning logic and access control policies.

Requirements

Requirements:
  • Possess 2 to 7 years of specialized experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) within the IT Services industry.
  • Demonstrate expert proficiency with SailPoint IdentityIQ, including deep knowledge of Rules, Provisioning, and Workflow XML.
  • Show strong command over scripting languages, specifically BeanShell and Java, for custom solution development.
  • Have hands-on experience managing Identity Lifecycle Management (JML) and handling complex Account and Attribute Requests.
  • Be well-versed in directory services and cloud identity platforms, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and LDAP.
  • Exhibit practical knowledge of integration patterns with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and ServiceNow via REST APIs.
  • Possess proven ability to troubleshoot production environments and manage privileged access tools like CyberArk.
  • Hold a professional background in IAM and Identity Governance, with a track record of delivering secure and scalable identity solutions.

Job Title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Backend-Focused)

Location: Remote – Mexico Only
Type of Contract: Full-Time | Remote
Salary Range: 3K - 4K
Language Requirements: Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)

Our client is seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer with strong backend engineering expertise, particularly in Python, AWS, API development, and middleware integrations. You will play a key role in supporting their Private Wealth and Digital Banking technology teams, working closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO) and serving as a technical liaison between business stakeholders and the offshore development team in India. Your work will directly impact platform integration, application performance, and the successful delivery of ongoing technology enhancements within their InvestCloud ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Technical Product Owner and internal stakeholders to understand technical requirements, define priorities, and support development initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical bridge between the TPO and offshore development team in India, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and efficient delivery.
  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations using Python and AWS.
  • Support the development and expansion of the data catalogue powering the InvestCloud platform, including Python-based API development.
  • Develop and maintain middleware solutions and integrations between the Private Wealth InvestCloud platform and Digital Banking applications.
  • Provide technical oversight through code reviews, evaluating offshore development deliverables, identifying gaps, and recommending improvements to engineering practices.
  • Support application maintenance, platform upgrades, certificate changes, troubleshooting, and ongoing enhancements while maintaining clear technical documentation and architecture specifications.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Senior-level experience in full stack software development, with a strong focus on backend engineering.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, particularly backend services, RESTful API development, and application integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud technologies and services.
  • Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience working across cloud-based and on-premises environments.
  • Strong understanding of API architecture, middleware, system integrations, and data exchange.
  • Experience collaborating with offshore or globally distributed development teams, including reviewing technical work and providing actionable feedback.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, document solutions, and work independently with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Frontend development experience with React and/or React Native.
  • Previous experience in financial services, banking, private wealth management, or investment technology.
  • Experience working with InvestCloud or similar wealth management platforms.
  • Familiarity with digital banking applications and enterprise system integrations.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications with large enhancement and maintenance backlogs.
  • Previous experience as a Technical Lead or technical liaison between Product Owners and software development teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior engineer with strong backend development capabilities who is comfortable working across the full technology stack. They should be confident leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, reviewing offshore development work, and helping the Technical Product Owner move initiatives forward.

Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, independent problem-solving, proactive communication, and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams across Mexico, the United States, and India.

Important Location Requirement: This opportunity is exclusively open to candidates based in Mexico who can work with significant overlap with U.S. business hours.
